title: Software Developer Intern- 2027 Glasgow Summer R&D Internship
description:
:

**Software Developer Intern- Glasgow Summer R&D Internship 2027**

**Glasgow, Hybrid**

We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence - and questions into answers.

If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.

**About the Program**

Join one of the most exciting student opportunities in technology and innovation!

Each year, SAS welcomes a select group of interns to join us for a 10-12 week summer experience. In 2027, we will be hiring **8 R&D Interns** in our Glasgow office across a variety of teams.

As SAS's R&D hub in EMEA, Glasgow brings together talented engineers, developers, and innovators who build technology used by customers around the world. As an intern, you'll work alongside experienced teams on real projects, gain hands-on technical experience, and contribute to solutions used by our customers from day one.

You'll also become part of a vibrant intern community that extends beyond the summer internship. Alongside your fellow Summer Interns, you'll connect with year-round interns and recent graduates who began their careers through the same program. Many have chosen to continue their journey with SAS, reflecting the valuable learning opportunities, mentorship, and career growth the internship provides.

**Available Opportunities**

For our 2027 Summer R&D Internship Program, we are hiring **Full-Stack Developers** and **Backend Developers** across the following R&D teams in Glasgow:

* **Model Manager**
* **Analytics Lifecycle**
* **Intelligent Decisioning**
* **Compute Engineering**
* **GenAI Platform**
* **Analytics**

Regardless of the team you join, you'll work alongside experienced engineers, gain practical development experience, and contribute to technology used by customers around the world.

**What you'll do**

As an intern, you will work on real releases for real customers under Agile and CI/CD methodologies, experiencing every part of the development process. You will be integrated into a product team from Day 1, allowing you to learn from the highest calibre of talented and experienced R&D staff. You can expect to:

* Design and implement new features.
* Work with product management, UX and UI designers to define and design new features
* Collaborate with development teams to draft technical specifications and designs
* Implement new product features
* Participate in code reviews
* Improve testing automation and integration into our testing and delivery pipeline
* Make a real difference – and get paid while doing it!

**Required qualifications**

* You are a penultimate year bachelor's student in one of the STEM Faculties.
* Strong communication skills – both written and verbal.
* You are available to start the internship in 2027 late May and continue through the summer for 10-12 weeks.
* You have good programming skills, in at least 1 modern programming language.
* You are familiar with basic computing concepts.
* You’re curious, passionate, authentic, and accountable. These are our values and influence everything we do.

**You are welcome here.**

At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.

**Additional Information:**

*SAS only sends emails from verified “sas.com” email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact* *Recruitingsupport@sas.com.*

Let's stay in touch! Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on company news, job updates and more.

title: Graduate Planner
description:
**About the role**

We are Balfour Beatty. You may not know us by name, but you’ll recognise what we do. We’re a leading international infrastructure group, building, maintaining and improving infrastructure that supports communities for generations to come.

As a Graduate Planner, you'll join our 2027 Early Careers programme and gain hands-on experience while contributing to some of the UK's most significant infrastructure projects. From day one, you'll take on real responsibility, develop technical and professional skills, and work alongside experienced colleagues who will support your growth. You'll also be part of a supportive graduate community, building the skills, experience and industry-recognised accreditations needed for a successful career.

In this role, you’ll join one of our Balfour Beatty Power T&D teams as a Graduate Planner, based in Middlesbrough, supporting projects across UK.

 **What you'll be doing**

As a Graduate Planner you’ll play an important role in supporting the planning and successful delivery of major infrastructure and construction projects. Working alongside experienced planners, engineers, and project teams, you'll apply your academic knowledge in a practical environment while developing the technical, analytical, and professional skills needed for a successful career in project planning and project controls.

You'll gain experience developing and maintaining project programmes, monitoring performance, analysing progress data, and supporting project teams to achieve delivery objectives. Through a structured graduate development programme, you'll build expertise in planning, project controls, programme management, forecasting, and project delivery while working towards professional accreditation..

You’ll support with:

* Supporting the day-to-day planning function across projects, helping to ensure programmes remain accurate, updated, and aligned with delivery requirements
* Developing, maintaining, and updating short-term and long-term project programmes to reflect progress and project changes
* Managing and updating project and contractual programmes in line with reporting requirements and project objectives
* Monitoring project progress, analysing programme performance, and identifying variances, risks, and opportunities
* Supporting the collection, analysis, and presentation of progress and performance information to support project decision-making
* Applying planning techniques including sequencing, logic development, critical path analysis, resource planning, and forecasting
* Producing planning reports, programme updates, dashboards, and performance information for project teams and stakeholders
* Supporting project controls activities, including baseline management, change management, and programme assurance
* Working with project teams to understand project requirements, construction activities, and delivery strategies
* Supporting forecasting activities relating to labour, plant, materials, subcontractors, and project resources
* Building strong working relationships with project managers, engineers, subcontractors, and other stakeholders to support successful project delivery
* Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance programme management, reporting, and project performance
* Using industry-standard planning software and digital tools to support project planning and controls activities

 **Who we're looking for**

We value your potential over past experience and are looking for graduates with a degree in Construction Management/Construction Planning and a genuine interest in our industry. To be eligible, you’ll need to achieve a minimum 2:2 honours degree by the time you start.

We’d love to receive your application if you:

* Are curious, proactive and motivated to develop professionally.
* Enjoy solving problems and finding practical solutions.
* Work well with others and build positive relationships.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with different people.
* Take ownership, adapt to challenges and are committed to achieving results.

Please note that this role may require travel to various locations, which means you may occasionally need to work and stay away from home. Flexibility is essential, as assignments can vary based on project needs. All reasonable travel and accommodation expenses will be reimbursed in accordance with company policy. Before joining Balfour Beatty, you must hold a full UK driver's license.

 **Why work for us as a Graduate**

* Work on high-profile projects that make a real difference, while building your career with one of the UK’s leading infrastructure groups.
* Be part of a supportive early careers network, with structured training and with structured training and coaching from experienced industry professionals.
* Take part in unique development experiences, including residential trips in the Lake District and personal development delivered by our external partners.
* Take ownership of your ongoing professional development, with support towards professional membership and chartership or professional registration where relevant to your career path.

**What we can offer you**

* Competitive salary and flexible benefits, giving you the freedom to shape a rewards package that works for you.
* 25 days' holiday, with the option to buy or sell additional days.
* A permanent contract from day one, reflecting our commitment to your long-term career.
* Clear progression opportunities, with bi-annual performance and pay reviews throughout your programme.
* Opportunities to connect with fellow graduates through networking events, development activities and our Early Careers Showcase.
* Opportunities to get involved in wider business initiatives, community projects and programmes such as the Duke of Edinburgh's Award.

 **About us**

The power sector is one of the fastest-growing areas in infrastructure, helping to keep homes, businesses and communities connected. It plays a vital role in supporting the UK's transition to a low-carbon future by strengthening electricity networks and enabling the integration of renewable energy sources.

At Balfour Beatty, our Power Transmission & Distribution teams work with regional, national and international electricity network owners and operators to deliver engineering solutions across the electricity grid, including overhead lines, cabling, substations and distribution networks.

From early-stage planning and design through to construction and maintenance, our teams help deliver some of the UK's most ambitious power projects, improving network resilience and supporting a more sustainable energy future.

At Balfour Beatty we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential components of any successful, happy workplace. Through our Value Everyone Diversity and Inclusion Strategy and Action Plan, we are growing our diverse workforce and developing our inclusive culture where everyone is able to thrive and reach their full potential, regardless of their identity or background. To find out how we are making this a reality, visit www.balfourbeatty.com/diversityandinclusion

To help and support us with our desired commitment to create an inclusive culture we are members of WISE, enei, Business Disability Forum and the Association for Black and Minority Ethnic Engineers (AFBE). In 2020, we signed the Audeliss and Involve Open Letter to demonstrate our commitment to taking key long term and sustainable actions on Black Inclusion. Balfour Beatty is also a Gold Award holder in the Ministry of Defence 'Employer Recognition Scheme' and actively encourage applications from Armed Forces personnel, veterans and reservists.

As a Disability Confident Employer, we are committed to working with people who have disabilities and long-term health conditions to remove barriers for them in obtaining employment. For more info, visit: https://disabilityconfident.campaign.gov.uk/

We're committed to making our recruitment process as inclusive as possible. If you need any adjustments, please let us know at any stage of the process.

title: Software Engineering Intern (2027 Start) - London
description:
P-1601

As a Software Engineering Intern, you will join a team of engineers to build features that contribute directly to the Databricks platform. We're hiring across all of our teams, including full stack, backend, infrastructure, systems, tools, cloud, databases, and customer-facing products. At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees.

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. title: Graduate Product Engineer Opportunities 2027
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Your role in the team**

The Allstate Early Career Development Programme is designed to help you launch your career in technology. As a full-time Graduate Product Engineer, you will work directly within an Allstate Technology Solutions team, gaining hands on experience and exposure to high impact projects while helping to solve real business problems using modern technologies.  
  
You will contribute to the development of high quality, scalable applications and systems that deliver value for Allstate and its customers. Working across the full technology stack, you will gain hands on experience with a range of modern technologies and engineering practices, which may include programming languages such as Java, Python and JavaScript, cloud platforms, APIs, databases, DevOps tools, and front-end and back-end development frameworks used to deliver innovative products and solutions for Allstate and its customers.  
  
The ANI Early Careers training programme provides a structured introduction to Allstate, combining onboarding, business awareness and professional skills development. A key focus is building AI literacy from day one, with dedicated sessions on AI fundamentals and practical AI learning, alongside training in communication, resilience, decision making and customer experience. The programme helps graduates build early connections, understand the business and develop the skills needed to thrive in a technology-driven environment. After six months of various learnings online and in person, we ask participants to present their growth journey, reflecting on both their technical achievements and personal development since joining the organisation. Training and development activities during the programme will be delivered in person to provide hands-on learning and networking opportunities.  
  
Programme Highlights  
  

* Hands-on experience as part of an Agile technology team.
* Mentorship and support from senior leaders and technical experts.
* Opportunities to work with modern and innovative technologies.
* Exposure to real business challenges and customer focused solutions.
* Structured learning and development opportunities.
* Opportunities to develop your technical, professional and leadership capabilities.
* A collaborative and inclusive working environment.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

  

* Consumer Journey Advocacy & Domain Expertise: Contribute across the full technology stack, working with modern programming languages, frameworks, and cloud technologies.

* Outcome-Based Iterative Delivery: Help define product requirements, prioritise features, and collaborate with teams to meet goals.
* Design & Systems Thinking: Use design thinking principles to create user-centric digital products and solve complex problems.
* Impact & Influence: Foster a positive team culture, effectively influence stakeholders, and communicate with clarity.
* Key Performance Indicator & Performance Measurement: Track and measure key performance indicators to evaluate success and iterate for improvement.

**Essential Skills**

  

* All applicants must demonstrate they have a legal right to work in the UK for employment at Allstate. Allstate is not providing sponsorship for this program.
* Are completing by September 2027 or have recently completed (within the last 2 years), a practical, engineering-focused IT degree or related discipline, with a minimum degree classification of 2:1 or commendation.
* Have less than one year of relevant professional experience gained after graduation.
* Have strong programming and system design fundamentals.
* Are curious, collaborative, and passionate about building meaningful, high‑quality products.

* Applicants must provide a note of their average module marks to date or the classification they have been awarded if already graduated. **Failure to do so will result in withdrawal from the recruitment process.**

**As part of the recruitment process, shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend an in-person assessment centre in early November 2026.**

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

  

* This job does not have supervisory duties.

**Job Posting End Date: Saturday 31****st** **October 2026 [11:59pm]**

**#LI-PB2**

**Skills**

Software Development

### **Shape the Future of Insurance with Cutting-Edge Tech and a People-First Culture**

**Why join us?**  
Allstate NI is proud to be Allstate’s European Digital Centre of Excellence, a hub for innovation and engineering excellence. We’re recent winners of Best Place to Work in IT (100+ employees) and Best Use of Cloud Services at the Belfast Telegraph IT Awards, and we’ve been recognised for our community and sustainability impact with Platinum in the Northern Ireland Environmental Benchmarking Survey.

We’re a product-driven, cloud-first organisation delivering real outcomes through modern technology, a digital product-centric talent model, and a culture rooted in engineering excellence. Our teams work in cross-functional structures, guided by an outcome-based delivery approach that accelerates speed, agility, and value.

We also invest in you. At Allstate NI, your career growth matters. You’ll have access to our Continuous Learning Hub, designed to support skills development and professional advancement through tailored learning paths, certifications, and mentoring opportunities. Whether you’re deepening technical expertise or exploring leadership roles, we provide the tools and support to help you thrive.

### **What do you get in return?**

As well as receiving a competitive annual salary, our reward package includes:

  

* Corporate bonus scheme
* Pension scheme
* Annual performance-related pay reviews
* Life assurance and income protection
* Flexible working options
* Hybrid working
* Private medical and dental insurance
* Access to an employee assistance programme
* Discounted gym membership
* Two paid volunteering days each year
* Cycle to work scheme

Be part of a high-performing, socially responsible organisation where your work has purpose, and your growth is supported every step of the way.

title: Senior Engineer (B3) Built Environment (BS/BE)
description:
**Date:** 2 Oct 2026

**Location:** Palestra, Southwark, TfL Corporate

**Company:** TfL, GLA or OPDC

**Job title:** Senior Engineer (B3) Built Environment (BS/BE)

**Salary:** £70,000.00 - £76,500.00 (depending on skills, knowledge and experience)  
**Grade:** Pay Band 3

**Contract type:** TfL **Reference:** 5846

**Team:** Built Environment **Directorate:** Engineering

**Contract details:** Permanent **Location:** Southwark,London + various locations across London

  

**Application closing date: 18th of October at 23:59**

All offers of employment are subject to satisfactory right‑to‑work checks. Candidates must be able to demonstrate their right to work in the UK. At the present time TfL is unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

  

* Hybrid working within this role enables a balance of 50 per cent of time split between the office and home over a 4-week period. Hybrid working arrangements can evolve subject to business requirements.

  

**Overview of role**

  

Providing specialist technical input related to Built Environment, buildings and urban realm structures in support of TfL projects and asset management. This may include architectural design, inspection and maintenance of urban realm structures, technical input to signage, discipline specific construction engineering, project engineering and building control activities. Safeguarding the safety, integrity and efficiency of the urban realm structures assets at all stages in the asset life cycle through engagement in planning, design, construction, operation, maintenance and assessment activities.

  

**Key Accountabilities**

  

* Ensures the safety, functionality or compliance of low to medium risk newly implemented or altered assets, engineering processes, procedures or systems
* Leads the development and implementation of low complexity engineering solutions within their stated discipline or functional specialism, through the application of defined engineering standards and governance
* Provides internal stakeholders with appropriate challenge and professional advice to ensure the development or delivery of high quality, tested engineering solutions
* Undertakes on-site risk-based monitoring and surveillance of works as required, resolving and or escalating risks and issues as appropriate
* Maintains working knowledge of applicable standards, design codes and legislation applicable to their discipline or functional specialism
* Evaluates, selects and applies appropriate solutions to low risk/value/complexity engineering problems that improve efficiency or effectiveness, while improving safety and reducing operating costs.
* Makes technical recommendations for own discipline or functional specialism to customers or senior management to inform technical decision making
* Supports continuous improvement through the use of best practice, innovation, whole life cost optimisation and effective root cause analysis
* Monitors and supports the development of junior engineers, graduates and apprentice surveyors, providing appropriate technical guidance, mentoring and performance feedback to build capability and ensure the consistent application of engineering standards and best practice.

  

**Skills, Knowledge & Experience**

  

Knowledge

  

* Ideally the candidate will be either a Registered Architect; Chartered Building Surveyor; Chartered Building Engineer; or a Chartered Builder. Essential
* If the candidate is an Architect the candidate shall be a Registered Architect with the Architects Registration Board (ARB). Essential
* For other Built Environment disciplines the candidates will ideally be a Member of their respective professional institution as follows: Building Surveyor – Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS) or other relevant internationally recognised institution. Building Engineer / Builder – Chartered Institute of Building (CIOB), Chartered Association of Building Engineers (CABE) or other relevant internationally recognised institution. Essential
* Good knowledge of legislation, technical standards and industry best practice related to Built Environment Essential
* Good knowledge of health, safety and environmental considerations applicable to Built Environment Essential
* Good knowledge of some of the following: design, construction, operation, maintenance and assessment of Built Environment assets Essential
  

Skills

  

* Ability to lead design of Built Environment assets Essential
* Ability to assess the condition of Built Environment assets Essential
* Ability to maintain and undertake asset management of Built Environment assets Essential
  

Experience

  

* Significant experience in several of the following areas: conception, specification, design, construction, testing, commissioning, bringing into use, operation and or disposal of assets, systems or changes to engineering practice Essential
* Broad experience of managing multi-disciplinary engineering teams or applying subject matter expertise to resolve complex technical challenges Desirable
* Broad experience of applying professional engineering judgement to support significant value programmes, projects or operational activities Essential
* Broad experience of building relationships with and influencing a wide range of stakeholder at all levels within and outside of the organisation Essential
* Extensive experience in Built Environment asset design, construction, operation and maintenance. Essential

  

**Application Process**

  

* Please apply using your CV and 1 page cover letter

* Think carefully about the skills, knowledge and experience in the advert and cover this in your CV

* PDF format preferred and do not include any photographs or images

  

**Equality, diversity and inclusion**

  

We are committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion and aim to reflect the diverse communities we serve. We believe that a diverse workforce enables us to deliver better services and outcomes. Our goal is to make our recruitment as inclusive as possible. As a Disability Confident Leader, we actively encourage applications from disabled people. As part of the Disability Confident scheme, we aim to offer an assessment or interview to candidates who apply via the scheme where the minimum essential criteria for skills, knowledge and experience has been met. In some circumstances, it may not be practical to offer an interview or assessment to every candidate who applies through the scheme and meet the minimum essential criteria; in these situations, we select candidates who best meet the minimum criteria for the job rather than interviewing all who meet them.

  

Across all recruitment activity, we recognise that selection methods may vary depending on the nature and scale of the campaign and will be applied fairly, consistently and proportionately in line with our Disability Confident commitments.

  

We also use anonymising software that removes identifying information from CVs and cover letters to make the process fair***.***

  

**Benefits**

  

In return for your commitment and expertise, you will enjoy excellent benefits and scope to grow. Rewards vary according to the level of role but mostly include the below:

Final salary pension scheme
  
Free travel for you on the TfL network
  
Reimbursement of 75% of the cost of a standard class Ticket for National Rail travel from home
  
30 days annual leave plus public and bank holidays
  
TfL is committed to work-life balance, operating a hybrid working approach where business and role requirements allow
  
Private healthcare discounted scheme (optional)
  
Tax-efficient cycle-to-work programme
  
Retail, health, leisure and travel offers
  
Discounted Eurostar travel

  

We will make every effort to give you as much notice as possible, however some interviews/assessments could be organised at short notice.

**Vetting Process**

  

At Transport for London, safety, trust and fairness sit at the heart of how we recruit. Our Vetting Charter (https://tfl.gov.uk/corporate/careers/our-vetting-process) explains the checks we carry out before you join us, helping ensure we create a safe, inclusive and reliable network for everyone who depends on our services. We simply ask that the information you provide is honest and accurate so we can progress your application smoothly. If something doesn’t match or can’t be verified, we may not be able to move forward with your application, but we’ll always treat you with transparency, respect, and clear communication throughout.

title: Graduate Town Planner - Birmingham or Nottingham
description:
Town Planning

UKIMEA Region



BIR0000SX Requisition #

Graduate Town Planner - Birmingham or Nottingham

See it differently - Early Careers at Arup

See it differently

You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.

Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.

The Opportunity

With 150 town planners across 17 UK offices, Arup's Town Planning team works on some of the UK's most high-profile and complex projects, providing end-to-end planning and policy advice to public authorities, infrastructure providers, developers, property companies and landowners. Our work spans planning policy, spatial strategy, regeneration, major infrastructure planning, development management and research, helping to deliver more sustainable, resilient and inclusive places. As part of a multidisciplinary firm, we work closely with engineers, environmental specialists, urban designers and economists to tackle challenges such as housing delivery, climate change and infrastructure provision.

The role would be based within either our Birmingham or Nottingham offices, working as part of a wider national network of town planners. We are working on projects of national significance that will shape the future of the region. Our infrastructure work includes planning for the sustainable growth of Birmingham Airport, ensuring that the region has the energy it needs by planning for major new grid connections as well as working on new nationally important reservoirs. Our policy work includes working with both the East Midlands and West Midlands Combined Authorities to support the preparation of Spatial Development Strategies and establishing an exciting new vision for Nottingham’s future regeneration.

In this role you will:

Support the preparation of planning applications, planning policy documents, spatial strategies and evidence-based studies for public and private sector clients.

Undertake research, data analysis and report writing to inform planning, development, regeneration and major infrastructure projects, applying digital tools, GIS and AI-assisted techniques to interrogate evidence and communicate findings clearly.

Contribute to environmental, socio-economic and other impact assessments that support planning and consent processes.

Assist with stakeholder and community engagement activities, including workshops, consultations and meetings.

Work collaboratively as part of multi-disciplinary teams with planners, engineers, urban designers, environmental specialists, economists and other experts to deliver sustainable and inclusive places.

Help us use digital and AI tools well – from spatial data, dashboards and visualisation to automating routine policy and site analysis – so that our advice is quicker to produce, easier to understand and better evidenced.

https://www.arup.com/projects/ratcliffe-on-soar-power-station-site/

Is this role right for you?

For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes:

An undergraduate or bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline, such as Urban Planning, Architecture, Geography & Geospatial Science or Urban Design. RTPI-accredited degrees are preferred, and we will support you through your RTPI Assessment of Professional Competence.

Desirable technical skills include experience using GIS, mapping or spatial analysis software (e.g. ArcGIS or QGIS); comfort with data handling and visualisation tools (e.g. Excel, Power BI); and a practical, critical interest in how AI and automation can be applied responsibly to planning tasks such as evidence review, consultation analysis, site appraisal and reporting.

To be considered for a graduate opportunity, your application must include a copy of your academic transcript and meet the following criteria:

Full working rights in the country of application

No more than 12 months of full-time experience in a comparable role

Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts.

Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes;

* Changemakers: You care about sustainable development and want to see your work make a genuine difference.

* Innovative minds: You think critically, ask hard questions, and are genuinely open to new approaches.

* Growth seekers: You are curious, actively seek feedback, and look for ways to keep developing.

* Adaptable adventurers: You are comfortable with uncertainty and adapt readily as projects and priorities evolve.

You should be able to start this opportunity on **1 September 2027.**

**Advert Closing Date:** **16 October 2026**

Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended.

**Eligibility:**

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Therefore, you must ensure that you are eligible to work permanently in the UK without our sponsorship.

What we offer you

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates.

We also provide for our permanent members Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Next Steps

We've designed our application process to be straightforward and supportive, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills and potential. Applications are reviewed as they're received, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.

The process includes an online application, psychometric testing, application review, case study, interview and offer stage. Our friendly Early Careers team is available throughout the process to answer questions and help you feel confident every step of the way.

  

Different people, shared values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas - this drives our excellence.

See it differently

As part of a multidisciplinary firm, we work closely with engineers, environmental specialists, urban designers and economists to tackle challenges such as housing delivery, climate change and infrastructure provision.

We are working on projects of national significance that will shape the future of the region. Our infrastructure work includes planning for the sustainable growth of Birmingham Airport, ensuring that the region has the energy it needs by planning for major new grid connections as well as working on new nationally important reservoirs. Support the preparation of planning applications, planning policy documents, spatial strategies and evidence-based studies for public and private sector clients.

Undertake research, data analysis and report writing to inform planning, development, regeneration and major infrastructure projects, applying digital tools, GIS and AI-assisted techniques to interrogate evidence and communicate findings clearly.

Assist with stakeholder and community engagement activities, including workshops, consultations and meetings.

At Osprey, we specialise in delivering innovative heavy transport and lifting solutions for major infrastructure projects across the UK and beyond.

With over 25 years of expertise, we work on projects that shape the future, transporting and installing critical assets across sectors including renewables, nuclear, defence, civil engineering, marine, oil and gas.

From moving a 4,000-tonne railway bridge to transporting 107-metre offshore wind turbine blades, our projects are often among the largest and most technically challenging in the world.

As a family-owned business built on long-term relationships, we're proud of our collaborative culture, engineering excellence and commitment to developing the next generation of talent.

**Kick-start Your Engineering Career with Osprey**

As part of our Year in Industry Programme, you'll join a team of highly experienced Structural Engineers, Project Engineers and Senior Project Engineers, gaining valuable hands-on experience across a wide range of specialist projects.

You’ll also take part in our SOAR Early Careers Programme, a structured development pathway that combines technical learning, professional skills training, and peer networking to support your career growth.

This is a unique opportunity to apply the engineering knowledge you've gained at university to real-world projects, while developing practical skills that will help shape your future career.

You'll work alongside industry experts, contribute to live projects, and gain exposure to every stage of the engineering process, from concept and planning through to project delivery.

**Your Role**

As a Year in Industry Engineer, you'll support the Engineering team in developing safe, efficient and innovative solutions for heavy transport and lifting operations.

Reporting to a Senior Project Engineer, you'll gain practical experience across a variety of engineering projects, working closely with operational teams, clients and fellow engineers.

**In this role, you will:**

* Support the development of engineering solutions for complex transport and lifting projects.

* Assist with structural calculations and engineering assessments.

* Support the preparation of technical proposals and tender submissions.

* Create and amend engineering drawings using AutoCAD or similar software.

* Collaborate with project teams to develop practical solutions that meet client requirements.

* Visit project sites and gain first-hand experience of engineering operations.

* Apply engineering principles to solve real-world technical challenges.

* Work closely with experienced engineers to develop your technical knowledge and professional skills.

* Ensure all work is carried out in line with Osprey's Health, Safety, Environmental and Quality (HSEQ) standards.

* Contribute ideas and support continuous improvement initiatives across the Engineering team.

**About You**

We're looking for enthusiastic and ambitious students who are eager to learn, develop new skills and gain valuable industry experience.

You'll be:

* Currently studying towards a degree in Mechanical, Structural, Civil or Construction Engineering.

* Seeking a Year in Industry placement as part of your degree programme.

* A strong problem solver with analytical thinking skills.

* An excellent communicator who enjoys working collaboratively with others.

* Organised, proactive and able to manage multiple tasks effectively.

* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

* Familiar with AutoCAD or similar engineering software.

* Willing to travel to sites when required.

* Passionate about engineering and motivated to learn from experienced professionals.

* A full UK driving licence would be advantageous but is not essential.

**What You'll Receive**

We believe in investing in future talent and providing meaningful opportunities to learn and develop.

As a Year in Industry Engineer at Osprey, you'll benefit from:

* Competitive salary

* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

* Enhanced employer pension contributions

* Private medical insurance

* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements

* Cycle2Work scheme

* Employee Assistance Programme

* Structured on-the-job training and mentoring

* Exposure to high-profile engineering and infrastructure projects

* Opportunities to build valuable industry experience and professional networks

* Support from experienced engineers throughout your placement

**Why Choose Osprey?**

At Osprey, you'll do more than observe. You'll be given genuine responsibility, trusted to contribute, and encouraged to develop your knowledge through hands-on experience.

Whether you're supporting the movement of critical infrastructure, developing engineering calculations, or working alongside project teams on-site, you'll play a meaningful role in delivering some of the UK's most exciting and technically challenging projects.

Many of our placement students go on to pursue graduate opportunities, making this an excellent first step towards a long-term engineering career.

**Ready to Build Your Future?**

If you're looking for a placement that combines technical challenge, professional development and the opportunity to work on unique engineering projects, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Graduate Software Engineer
description:
Location

Aberdeen, United Kingdom

Category

Engineering

Date Published

30/09/26

Status

Open

**About the job:**

Kent is looking for a Graduate Software Engineer to be based in Aberdeen.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make a difference and engineer solutions that make not only the UK’s energy security stronger but actively impact the way in which the world drives towards a net zero future?

Our Engineering & Consulting Software Development team works closely with our clients to develop high-quality software solutions that add real value to their operations. By combining high-end technical knowledge with modern software development, the team provides its clients with the tools needed to efficiently and reliably solve many of the Energy industry’s technical challenges, across a wide range of disciplines. As a graduate in our team, you will be working on intelligent and useful software to support some of the most challenging engineering projects, helping shape the future of energy. You will get involved in the full software development lifecycle, solving exciting challenges and growing into a high-quality software engineer.

**About our Graduate Scheme**

Our people are our power. At Kent, diverse perspectives and talents are the backbone of our strength. We’re building an environment where everyone, from engineers to scientists, from all walks of life, can thrive and reach their full potential.

If you’re passionate about making an impact and pushing boundaries, Kent is where you belong. We are a future-focused company, reimagining energy with ambition and innovation.

Our global graduate program offers hands-on experience, mentorship from industry leaders, and the opportunity to grow as part of a diverse and driven team. We’re building the next generation of leaders in engineering, science, and technology, and we want you to be a part of it.

**Application Process**

As part of the application process, candidates will be required to provide confirmation of the academic modules completed during their university studies. This information will help us assess the relevance of your academic background to the role. Please ensure that confirmation of your completed modules is submitted alongside your CV as part of your application.

**Application Deadline**

All applications must be received by **Friday 23****rd** **October 2026**.

**Recruitment Timeline**

Shortlisting and pre-screening of applications will commence in early November. Candidates selected to progress to the next stage will be invited to interview, with interviews scheduled to take place from late November to early December 2026.

**Eligibility**

Please note that candidates must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for this opportunity.

**Hybrid Working**

We follow a hybrid working model that combines office and remote work, with a requirement to be in the offices three days a week. This approach supports the development of a strong and effective team dynamic.

**Power the future with us. Unleash your energy**

**Skills & Responsibilities:**

As a software developer joining our Engineering & Consulting Software Development team, you will:

* Become an integral part of a growing team, collaborating with your colleagues to develop, deliver and support a variety of innovative software solutions that meet clients’ requirements within time and budget constraints.

* Get involved in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering, design and implementation, through to testing, deployment, maintenance and support. We use a lean and agile methodology, giving you the opportunity to grow into a well-rounded developer, and allowing you to have an impact on every stage of a project.

* Deliver bespoke software applications using a range of modern technologies and platforms, from desktop applications and services to web and cloud solutions and Microsoft Office automation. The team will help you continuously improve your programming skills, learn new things and keep up to date with the latest developments in the industry.

* Solve logical and algorithmic problems, review them with the wider team, and implement these solutions into working software features.

* Learn and adhere to our software engineering standards, procedures and best practices, and provide suggestions for continuous improvements.

* Build and configure test environments and carry out unit and factory acceptance tests for our developed applications.

* Produce relevant user documentation and deployment guides.

* Provide support to our clients, both external and internal, for our growing portfolio of software products.

* Help deploy software applications and systems and provide training to end users when required.

* Be part of an excellent working environment, collaborating with technical experts across various domains and disciplines to produce software of the highest quality standards.

Our technology stack is mostly Microsoft-based: we develop software using .NET and Visual Studio, primarily in C#, but also VB.NET for legacy applications. We use Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) and legacy WinForms for our desktop apps, ASP.NET and Angular for web development, SQL Server and Azure for data. We also use Python for various data analytics or scripting solutions. You will also get to develop clever macros using VBA to help our engineering teams become more efficient and save time through automation. All of these will be supported by using Artificial Intelligence, particularly Large Language Models, to increase our development efficiency, so you will be gaining more experience with using some of the latest models.

In addition to the responsibilities listed herein, the employee may be required to perform other ad-hoc tasks as needed or directed by the supervisor or management. These tasks will be within the reasonable scope of the employee's skills, capabilities, and role within the organization. The intent of this provision is to allow for flexibility and adaptability in meeting the dynamic needs of the organization, ensuring that operational requirements can be met efficiently. All such tasks will be assigned considering the employee's current workload and with respect to their professional development.

**Your knowledge/skills, education, and experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or similar / related field).

* Experience in software development, preferably using .NET (C# or VB.NET) or Python, gained through work experience, degree coursework or self-study. Ideally, you will have used .NET, SQL in the past and have experience with desktop and web development (preferably with some of WPF, WinForms, ASP.NET MVC and WebAPI, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular, but not essential). We will help you constantly improve your skills and become a great developer, as long as you are passionate about technology, software development, and artificial intelligence, and willing to learn and adapt to the rapid pace of the industry.

* Understanding of software development principles and strong commitment to delivering to high quality standards, constantly looking for innovation and improvements, whilst futureproofing your work

**Communication:**

* Excellent command of the English language in both oral and written communication and skills.

**Behaviour/ Core Competencies:**

* Technically minded with strong analytical and logical problem-solving skills. A passion for solving difficult challenges, and persistence are desirable.

* Able to work in an agile environment, adapting to various domains and coping with uncertainty and changing requirements.

* Ability to work in a team, across a variety of projects and technologies and to prioritise workload, ensuring that quality and timeliness of deliverables is met.

* Creativity and strong communication skills for both business and technical audiences.

* A practical mind and being self-motivated, hard-working and reliable.

* We are looking for candidates who are due to graduate in 2027, or have graduated in the last 2 years.

**HSSEQ:**

The Employee shall observe the Health, Safety, Sustainability, Environment and Quality rules of the Company; it’s clients and the governing authorities of the host country.

We are committed to our diverse and inclusive community - a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop. From day one, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, and employee networks to support staff from different backgrounds.

As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures, and abilities.

We’re a disability-friendly employer and can make adjustments to support you to perform at your best during the recruitment process. Please contact us confidentially at recruitment.uk@kentplc.com to find out how we can support you.

title: Java Developer
description:
***Please note this role requires 2 days a week at Mastek office due to the nature of work.***

  

**About the Company**

Mastek Limited is a global provider of enterprise AI, digital, and cloud services, enabling clients to achieve measurable and sustainable returns on their technology investments. The company has a presence in over 40 countries and a skilled workforce of close to 5,000 employees. Through its "Lead with AI" approach, Mastek integrates intelligence across its solutions and operations, enabling organisations to accelerate transformation using ethical, scalable, and domain-driven AI adoption.

Mastek partners with industry leaders including Oracle, Salesforce, Microsoft, AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks, serving key sectors such as Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, Higher Education, and Financial Services. With its core values of Trust, Value, and Velocity, Mastek empowers organisations to transform their business through innovative technology solutions while fostering a culture of collaboration, growth, and continuous learning.

  

**About the Role**

Mastek is set to deliver a high-profile programme for a central government department. The programme represents the next generation of the UKs biometric capability replacing and integrating with legacy systems and other government departments.

You will be part of a Mastek team in a multi-vendor project with a shared code base. As a Java full stack developer you will be responsible for designing and developing cloud native applications using cutting edge technologies.

The role requires in-depth understanding of the software development lifecycle and strong technical experience with an open-minded attitude and ability to rapidly adapt and learn.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Led a team of Java developers to deliver high-quality software solutions

* Work collaboratively with other teams to ensure seamless integration of software components
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices and coding standards
* Actively participating in architectural & design discussions
* Experience with Agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
* Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance to the team
* Take ownership of scrum team’s timelines and deliverables
* Proposing solutions to complex problems that are in the boundary of the existing system architecture

**Desirable Skills:**

* Experience with Performance and Monitoring tools: JMeter, Kibana, Splunk, Dynatrace
* Experience writing Shell script
* Understanding of Python
* Good understanding on AWS services (EC2, ECS, EKS, API Gateway and Serverless technologies)
* Integration Engine tools: Apache Camel and Active MQ for messaging, web services and distributed systems
* Public Sector domain experience preferable

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant cloud or software engineering certifications are advantageous.

  

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on large-scale digital transformation initiatives within the Banking & Financial Services sector.
* Collaborate with high-performing engineering, architecture, and cloud teams.
* Gain exposure to modern AWS-native technologies and engineering practices.
* Contribute to complex, business-critical solutions that deliver real customer value.
* Access continuous learning, professional development, and career progression opportunities.
* Be part of a collaborative and inclusive environment that encourages innovation and technical excellence.

  

If you are passionate about building secure, scalable software solutions and want to play a key role in delivering modern cloud-based platforms within a leading financial services environment, we would love to hear from you.

  

**Our UK Benefits Include:**

* Competitive salary and annual bonus opportunities
* Hybrid and flexible working options

* Private medical insurance ((for self & dependents))

* Gym and wellbeing support initiatives
* Learning and development opportunities, including access to certifications and training

Mastek is a trusted digital engineering and cloud transformation partner delivering innovative solutions to public and private sector organisations globally. We foster an inclusive, collaborative culture where diverse perspectives are valued, and every employee is empowered to make an impact.

**At Mastek, we are committed to building a diverse workforce and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can succeed. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunities employer.**

title: Software Development Intern
description:
**Job Summary:**

As a Software Development Intern, you'll work alongside engineers and mentors to design, build, test, and ship software as part of our dynamic team at CWAN. You'll join our Beacon Core Engineering team, which builds a large part of Beacon Cloud, sitting just above the platform abstraction layer.

The team builds the developer tools (SDLC) we offer to clients and use internally, including:

* **Developer experience:** IDE tooling with AI agent integration, code review, test frameworks, and release processes
* **Runtime execution:** batch and supercomputer (HPC) schedulers, containerization
* **Shared libraries:** including the dependency-graph and deal-model libraries used by the financial layer, by clients, and internally

You'll gain hands-on experience building and operating cloud-native systems on AWS and Azure, and work with AI agents that speed up development — both for our own team and for the clients we help adopt them safely.

**Responsibilities**

* Learn the team's tools, coding standards, and development workflow (Git, ticketing, CI/CD) with mentor support.
* Collaborate across the software development lifecycle: requirements, design, implementation, testing, and release.
* Use AI agents to accelerate your own development work, and help advise clients and internal teams on using them safely.
* Implement well-scoped features and bug fixes, following established patterns and best practices.
* Build and maintain automated tests (unit and/or integration) and verify changes meet acceptance criteria.
* Participate in design and code review discussions; communicate tradeoffs around performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Document technical changes and operational notes to support maintainability and troubleshooting.

**Required Skills**

* Coursework or project experience with an object-oriented language (e.g., Python, C++, Rust).
* Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.
* Ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively on a team.
* Openness to feedback and willingness to learn quickly.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Git and pull request workflows; familiarity with CI/CD.
* Exposure to backend frameworks and APIs (e.g., REST/JSON).
* Knowledge of AI coding assistant tools.
* Familiarity with testing tools and basic debugging practices.
* Experience with TypeScript or JavaScript is a plus.

**Education and Experience:**

* Current junior-level students pursuing a four-year degree in Computer Science or related field; freshmen, sophomores, and seniors will not be considered.

**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**

Discover a career in your hands at HMRC. Whether you're seeking purpose, growth, or a workplace that gives you a true sense of belonging, hear from some of our employees as they share their story about what its really like to work at HMRC.

Visit our YouTube channel to watch the full series and come and discover your potential.

At HMRC we are committed to creating a great place to work for all our colleagues; an inclusive and respectful environment that reflects the diversity of the society we serve.

We want to maximise the potential of everyone who chooses to work for us, and we offer a range of flexible working patterns and support to make a fulfilling career at HMRC accessible to you.

Diverse perspectives and experiences are critical to our success, and we welcome applications from all people from all backgrounds with the experience and skills needed to perform this role.

* Have you got a working knowledge of Java?
* Can you identify, triage and fix defects?
* Are you great at offering support and mentoring others?

If yes we would like you to be part of our outstanding team within Chief Digital Product Office, Digital Services.
  
  
Our purpose is to drive a customer centric approach to transforming services for HMRC Customers. Working closely with business stakeholders, contractors and suppliers - our aim is to drive digital innovation and to re-engineer services aligned to our IT, contractual and sourcing strategies and to deliver significantly improved digital services.

### **Job description**

You will be a key member of an Agile Scrum Team working across our Digital Application Support Service teams who are responsible for HMRC Self-Assessment digital service, ensuring users are able to get their tax right.

The team support customers, delivering change, enhancement and support for high-volume, business-critical HMRC digital service using Java.
  
  
Working as part of a scrum team you will have a key role in designing, building, and maintaining services that have a positive impact on over 12m users across HMRC.

### **Person specification**

Key responsibilities of this role include:

* Plan and lead development activities supporting legislative changes, service enhancements, maintenance and problem resolution within strict timescales.
* Put users first, translating user needs and user stories into effective technical solutions.
* Develop and maintain deep knowledge of the wider service architecture and support the development of others.
* Operate and support the live services you build, using monitoring and observability tools.
* Contribute to deployment activities and take ownership of production releases.
* Proactively improve service resilience, stability, scalability and maintainability.
* Support and mentor less experienced developers within the team.
* Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and engineering excellence.

**Essential Criteria:**

* Working as part of an agile software delivery team, leading on aspects of development work, providing guidance and setting development direction for more junior members of a team.
* Demonstrable working experience using Java 8 or newer and Spring Framework to deliver user-centred digital services.
* Demonstrable experience planning and leading development on related user stories.
* Experience of DevOps practices such as CI/CD (unit testing, TDD, Jenkins, Git, or similar).
* Evidence of taking ownership of risks and technical debt and ensuring theyre prioritised within the team alongside stakeholders.
* Problem solving and delivering a range of possible solutions, including through technical work and process improvement.
* Experience of evaluating data against business rules through rules engines such as Apache KiE  Drools.
* Operating a live service, using observability tooling such as Kibana, Grafana and Google Tag Manager, managing live incidents within an ITIL Framework.
* Knowledge of web security best practices, such as OWASP top 10.
* Experience of working with tools for API, performance, accessibility and security testing.

**Desirable Criteria:**

* Working knowledge of the Digital Application Support Services - Self Assessment application.
* Oracle Certified Professional Qualification.
* ITIL4 Foundation Qualification or be prepared to obtain it.
* Flexibility to work outside of normal business hours during Key Business Events.
* Working knowledge of GOV.UK Service Standard.
* Holds enhanced security vetting to SC level or be prepared to obtain it.
* Experience of working alongside Database Administrators (DBAs) to support in the diagnosis and resolution of data problems, sharing best practice on SQL queries.

**Further Location Information**

Please ensure that you only apply for a location that you are willing and able to work from, as we will only make one offer of employment. Any additional notes included in a Further Location Preferences (optional) field within the application form, will not be considered. Please be aware that you cannot change your location preference after submitting your application.

**Office closures**

For more information on where you might be working, review this information on our locations.

If your location preference is for one of the following sites, its important to note that these are not long-term sites for HMRC and we will require you to move to a new building in the future, subject to our location strategy and the applicable employee policies at that time.

These sites include:

* Telford Plaza, Telford - moving to Parkside Court, Telford

You will be given more information about what this means at the job offer stage.

### **Behaviours**

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:

* Changing and Improving
* Delivering at Pace
* Working Together

### **Technical skills**

We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:

* You will be provided a scenario at interview where we would like you to demonstrate your experience and the approach you would take to the problem. You will be asked to talk through your approach and may be asked follow-up questions.

**Benefits**
------------

Alongside your salary of £45,544, HM Revenue and Customs contributes £13,194 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .

HMRC operates both Flexible and Hybrid Working policies, allowing you to balance your work and personal commitments. We welcome applications from those who need to work a more flexible arrangement and will agree to requests where possible, considering our operational and customer service needs.

We offer a generous leave allowance, starting at 25 days and increasing by a day for every year of qualifying service up to a maximum of 30 days.

* Pension - We make contributions to our colleagues Alpha pension equal to at least 28.97% of their salary.
* Family friendly policies.
* Personal support.
* Coaching and development.

To find out more about HMRC benefits and find out what its really like to work for HMRChear from our insiders or visit Thinking of joining the Civil Service

**Things you need to know**
---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

### **Selection process details**

This vacancy is using Success Profiles , and will assess your Behaviours, Experience and Technical skills.

**How to Apply**

As part of the application process, you will be asked to provide the following:

* A name-blind CV including your job history, previous experiences and full qualification details.
* A 750-word Personal Statement. Your Personal Statement (max 750 words) should be used to describe your suitability for the advertised role, addressing the key responsibilities and essential criteria as outlined in the person specification part of the advert.

Please complete a separate statement (Max 250 words) for the Desirable Criteria where applicable. This is not essential for the role but may be considered by the vacancy-holder where candidates have the same scores at interview.

Further details around what this will entail are listed on the application form.

**Sift**

Prior to applications being sifted candidates will be asked to complete an additional IKM assessment. Candidates will be sent details of the assessment once the advert has closed. This assessment is a pass or fail and only those who pass will be considered at the sift stage.

In the event of a large number of applications being received, an initial sift may be held on the CV.

At full sift, your CV and your Personal Statement will be assessed, with the successful candidates being invited to interview.

We may also raise the score required at any stage of the process if we receive a high number of applications.

**Interview**

During the panel interviewyou will be asked behaviour-based and experience-based questions to explore what you are capable of. The experience based questions will be related to both the evidence provided and the targeted approach used, during the demonstration scenario.

Interviews will take place via video link.

Sift and interview dates to be confirmed.

Please note that circumstances may arise that require the planned interview format to change. We will endeavour to provide you with as much notice of any change as possible.

**Eligibility**

Please take extra care to tick the correct boxes in the eligibility sections of your application form. Mistakes sometimes happen but if you contact us later than two working days (Monday-Friday) before the vacancy closes, we may not be able to reopen your application for you. If you do make a mistake with your eligibility form, or have withdrawn yourself in error and need your application reinstated whilst the campaign is still live, please contact us via: unitybusinessservicesrecruitmentresults@hmrc.gov.uk  Use the subject line to insert appropriate wording for example  Please re-open my application  **[insert vacancy ref]** & vacancy closing date **[insert date]**.

To check that you are eligible to apply for this role, please review the eligibility information before submitting your application.

Exceptionally, candidates who are not successful at this grade may be considered for appointment to similar roles at a lower grade where the eligibility criteria are met. If this applies, we will contact you directly.

**Sponsorship**

We have assessed this role against both Home Office and HMRC criteria and we are unable to offer sponsorship for a Skilled Worker Visa. This means the vacancy is not open to applicants who require visa sponsorship.

**The HMRC app can help you with your application**

The HMRC app can provide you with your past 5 years' employment history, making the process of filling in your application quicker and easier.

If successful in your application, you will need your National Insurance number for the onboarding process.

Download the HMRC app now and save your National Insurance number to your digital phone wallet.

**How to download the HMRC app and sign up for an account**

Download the free HMRC app from the App Store or Google Play store.

If you have an HMRC online account already, sign straight in using your ID and password. If not, you can prove your identity by answering some questions or providing your photo ID.

Youll then be able to access the app quickly and easily by signing in using a 6-digit PIN, your fingerprint, or facial recognition.

You can find guidance for technical issues on GOV.UK: Technical support with HMRC online services.

**Reserve List**

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles  if this applies to you, well let you know via your Civil Service Jobs account.

**Merit List**

After interview, a single merit list will be created, and you will only be considered for posts in locations you have expressed a preference for. Appointments will be made in strict merit order in line with the set number of roles in each location.

**Criminal Record Check**

Applications received from candidates with a criminal record are considered fairly in accordance with the DBS Code of Practice and the Recruitment of ex-offenders Policy.

**Hybrid working at HMRC**

HMRC is an office-based organisation, and colleagues are expected to spend 60% of their working time in the office. Our offices provide opportunity for interaction, collaboration which aids learning and development and a sense of community. Where the role allows it, and where the home environment is suitable, colleagues can work from home for up to 2 days a week, averaged over a calendar month (or a proportionate amount of time for colleagues who work less than full time).

**Reasonable Adjustments**

We want to make sure no one is put at a disadvantage during our recruitment process. To assist you with this, we will reduce or remove any barriers where possible and provide additional support where appropriate.

If you need a change to be made so that you can make your application, you should:

* Contact the UBS Recruitment team via unitybusinessservicesrecruitmentresults@hmrc.gov.uk as soon as possible before the closing date to discuss your needs.

Complete the Assistance required section in the Additional requirements page of your application form to tell us what changes or help you might need further on in the recruitment process. For instance, you may need wheelchair access at interview, or if youre deaf, a Language Service Professional.

**IKM Assessment**

Prior to applications being sifted, candidates will be asked to complete an additional IKM assessment. Candidates will be sent details of the assessment once the advert has closed. This assessment is timed and is pass or fail; only those who pass will be considered at the sift stage. If you have any queries about the assessment, or require any reasonable adjustments, please contact talentacquisitionteam@hmrc.gov.uk

**Technical Support**

If you are experiencing problems that cannot be resolved by our help section, then technical support is available. You will receive a reply in 2 working days.

**Important information for existing HMRC contractual homeworkers**

This role may be suitable for existing HMRC employees who are contractual homeworkers. Occasional attendance to the office will be required where there is a business need. Please consider the advertised office locations for this role when applying and only select locations from the location preferences section that you can travel to.

**Terms and Conditions**

Customer facing roles in HMRC require the ability to converse at ease with members of the public and provide advice in accurate spoken English and/or Welsh where required. Where this is an essential requirement, this will be tested as part of the selection process.

HMRC has a presence in every region of the UK. For more information on where you might be working, review this information on our locations.

The Civil Service values honesty and integrity and expects all candidates to abide by these principles. The evidence you provide in your application must relate to your own experiences.

Any instances of plagiarism or other forms of cheating will be investigated and, if proven, the relevant application(s) will be withdrawn from the process.

Recording of interviews is prohibited unless explicit agreement is sought in line with the UK General Data Protection Regulations.

Questions relating to an individual application must be emailed as detailed later in this advert.

Applicants who are successful at interview will be, as part of pre-employment screening, subject to a check on the Internal Fraud Database (IFD). This check will provide information about employees who have been dismissed for fraud or dishonesty offences. This check also applies to employees who resign or otherwise leave before being dismissed for fraud or dishonesty had their employment continued. Any applicants details held on the IFD will be refused employment.

A candidate is not eligible to apply for a role within the Civil Service if the application is made within a 5 year period following a dismissal for carrying out internal fraud against government.

New entrants will join on the minimum of the pay band.

Please note that, if you are applying for roles on a part-time basis, the salary agreed will be pro-rata, reflective of the working hours agreed within your contract.

If you experience accessibility problems with any attachments on this advert, please contact the email address in the 'Contact point for applicants' section.

For more Information for people applying for, or thinking of applying for, roles at HM Revenue and Customs, please see link: Working for HMRC: information for applicants - GOV.UK.

  
  
  
Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview or assessment.

### **Security**

Successful candidates must undergo a standard (or equivalent) criminal record check.

People working with government assets must complete baseline personnel security standard (opens in new window) checks.

### **Nationality requirements**

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

* UK nationals
* nationals of the Republic of Ireland
