**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**

We are currently looking for a **Senior Developer (SQ Web)** to join our **Technology and Service Operations** Function within the **Digital and Technology Group**.

This is a **full-time** opportunity, on a **permanent** basis. The role will be based in 7/8 Wellington Place, Leeds, LS1 4AP.

Government departments and agencies are working towards implementing a minimum 60% attendance in office sites.

  

We are currently implementing a flexible, hybrid way of working, with a minimum of 8 days per month working on site to enable the collaboration and contact with partners and stakeholders needed to deliver MHRA business. Attendance on site is driven by business needs so depending on the nature of the role, this can flex up to 12 days a month, with the remainder of time worked either remotely or in the office. Some roles will need to be on site more regularly. Remote working is potentially available for some specific roles. Please discuss this with the recruiting manager before accepting an appointment.

### **Job description**

**Who are we?**

The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency enhance and improve the health of millions of people every day through the effective regulation of medicines and medical devices, underpinned by science and research.

The MHRA Digital and Technology Group (DTG) exists to help protect and improve public health by enabling the Agency to become a modern, intelligence-led regulator.

We bring together digital, data, technology, cyber security and artificial intelligence expertise to deliver services, platforms and insights that support the regulation of medicines, medical devices and healthcare technologies across the UK.

Our work goes beyond traditional IT. We design and deliver user-centred services, harness trusted data, apply advanced analytics and responsible AI, and build secure, resilient digital foundations that help the MHRA make better decisions, work more effectively and respond to a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape.

By joining DTG, you'll help shape the future of regulation while delivering technology that makes a real difference to public health.

The Technology & Service Operations (TSO) function is responsible for managing the existing IT infrastructure including both software and hardware, databases, and other technology platforms; leading the support and maintenance of applications; development and testing of new applications and platforms; and cyber and information security for the Agency.

The Engineering team, made up of software developers, DevOps engineers, Quality Assurance testers, and data professionals (including engineers, scientists, and visualization experts), is tasked with the creation of applications and services, ensuring quality for both new and existing agency offerings, and developing data visualizations through their expertise in data engineering and science.

### **Person specification**

**Role Purpose**

This Senior Developer role implements web applications and guides the ways in which the team works and provide technical leadership, to deliver cloud native web-based solutions to our end users. The post holder will be proficient in a wide range of technical systems and be involved in identifying appropriate technology and approaches, deciding when software should be written and will contribute to the developer community and promote knowledge sharing and adoption of good practice.

The post holder will work in cross-functional product squads on the design and development of creating cloud native (Azure), JavaScript based microservices (node.js) and front end (react) utilising agile (SAFe), paired programming, TDD and DevOps.

  

**Key responsibilities and results areas**

* As an experienced voice in the technical team, you will steer implementation and code design decisions for contingent labour and service providers

* Mentoring more junior members of your team to develop and maintain high-performance, scalable solutions

* Assist in leading the design and development of site/software projects following best practices, as well as regular status reporting

* Assist in leading in optimising, debugging, and enhancing existing software whilst preventing regression in live systems

* You must have solid JavaScript coding skills, experience of TDD/BDD (jest, enzyme, cucumber, gherkin), be collaborative (Jira, Confluence, GitHub)

* You will establish good engineering practices and have strong ability with Open Source, Cloud First, Microservices and DevOps principles and its associated technology like React, Next.js, Node.js, Rust, Azure services (AKS, CosmosDB, Blob Storage, Functions), Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker and CI/CD pipelines.

* Contribute to a collaborative, dynamic planning process - prioritising the work that needs to be done against the capacity and capability of the team ensuring the smooth and successful development of sites/software.

### **Behaviours**

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:

* Developing Self and Others
* Making Effective Decisions
* Seeing the Big Picture
* Communicating and Influencing

We only ask for evidence of these behaviours on your application form:

* Making Effective Decisions
* Seeing the Big Picture

### **Technical skills**

We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:

* You will hold a Computer Science or similar engineering degree, ideally hold a post-graduate qualification, or equivalent industry experience.
* You will ideally hold certifications with a major cloud provider (preferably in Azure) and as a microservice based full stack JavaScript developer.
* You will have previous experience as a developer working in a DDaT environment working on workstreams specific to the regulation of medicines/devices data and its subsequent caseworking.
* Substantial experience with certain tools and associated engineering processes.

**Benefits**
------------

Alongside your salary of £42,410, Medicines and Healthcare Products Regulatory Agency contributes £12,286 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .

* Annual Leave: 25 days annual leave on entry, rising by one day for each completed year of service to a maximum of 30 days and pro-rata for part-time staff. PLUS 8 bank holidays

* Privilege Leave: 1 day

* Hours of Work: 37 hours (net) per week for full time staff in all geographical locations, including London and pro rata for part-time staff

* Occupational Sick Pay (OSP): One month full pay/one month half pay on entry, rising by one month for each completed year of service to a maximum of six months full pay and six months half pay after five years service.

* Mobility: Mobility clause in contracts allowing staff to be mobile across the Civil Service

* Civil Service Pension Scheme. Please see the link for further information http://www.civilservicepensionscheme.org.uk/ For enquiries relating to the Civil Service Pension Schemes please contact MyCSP's Pension Service Centre directly on 0300 123 6666

* Flexible working to ensure staff maintain a healthy work-life balance

* Interest free season ticket loan or bike loan

* Employee Assistance Services and access to the Civil Service Benevolent Fund

* Eligibility to join Motoring , Boundless by CSMA

* Variety of staff and Civil Service clubs

* On-going learning and development

**Things you need to know**
---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

### **Selection process details**

This vacancy is using Success Profiles , and will assess your Behaviours, Strengths, Experience and Technical skills.

**Key dates** (dates are indicative only and could be subject to change)

* Closing date  11 October 2026 at 23:55
* Sifting  from 16 October 2026
* Main panel interviews  from 26 October 2026

Communications will be electronic via email therefore it is important that you check your Civil Service Jobs account regularly, as well as your spam/junk email folder.

Were committed to being diverse and inclusive, so please make your application anonymous by removing all identifying personal information (such as names and dates) from your employment history and personal statement.

**What will the process look like?**

**1. Sift Stage**

The main sift, where we'll read and score the rest of your application. This may involve a large number of applications, please bear with us as this can take some time.

* **Anonymised CV** which sets out your career history, previous experience and skills, highlighting specific responsibilities that are relevant for this role.
* **Personal statement:** Write a 500 word personal statement where you demonstrate how you meet the technical skills required for this role, providing examples to evidence your level of skill. In your personal statement we are looking for evidence of how you meet the role criteria and person specification. Your personal statement should aim to make use of the full wordcount and show how you meet the above criteria. Please give clear and specific examples of what you have done personally and the impact it has had.
* **Online application form**, including questions based on the Behaviour, Experience and Technical Success Profiles. Please ensure all application questions are completed in full; your application may not be considered if any responses are left blank.

The panel will look at your application and are looking for evidence of the stated points. We may raise the benchmark score required if we receive a high number of applications.

**2. Main Panel Interview**

Successful candidates from the sift stage will be invited to attend an interview. We use a blended interview technique, allowing us to find out more about you. We use the Success Profile framework and at interview we will be assessing Behaviours and Experience.

Your interview will include:

* Presentation, to be prepared as part of your interview, with further information being supplied when you reach this stage.

At interview, we will be asking questions relating to the following:

* Behaviours, as listed in the person specification
* Experience, as listed in the person specification
* Strengths, as listed in the person specification

Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview.

If you require any disability related adjustments at any point during the process, please contact careers@mhra.gov.uk as soon as possible.

Candidates will be subject to UK immigration requirements as well as Civil Service nationality rules. Further information on whether you are able to apply is available here.

Successful candidates must pass a disclosure and barring security check as well as animal rights and pro-life activism checks. People working with government assets must complete basic personnel security standard checks.

Certain roles within the MHRA will require post holders to have vaccinations, and in some circumstances, routine health surveillance. These roles include:

* Laboratory-based roles working directly with known pathogens
* Maintenance roles, particularly those required to work in laboratory settings
* Roles that involve visiting other establishments where vaccination is required
* Roles required to travel overseas where specific vaccination may be required.

Applicants who are successful at interview will be, as part of pre-employment screening subject to a check on the Internal Fraud Database (IFD). This check will provide information about employees who have been dismissed for fraud or dishonesty offences. This check also applies to employees who resign or otherwise leave before being dismissed for fraud or dishonesty had their employment continued. Any applicants details held on the IFD will be refused employment. A candidate is not eligible to apply for a role within the Civil Service if the application is made within a 5-year period following a dismissal for carrying out internal fraud against government.

Any move to the MHRA from another employer will mean you can no longer access childcare vouchers. This includes moves between government departments. You may however be eligible for other government schemes, including Tax-Free Childcare. Determine your eligibility here.

Individuals appointed on level transfer will retain their existing salary and are responsible for ensuring they fully understand the financial implications of any potential move and the impact (if any) on their terms. If an individual is in any doubt, they should seek clarification before accepting a job offer.

Staff joining on promotion will receive up to a 10% increase of their current basic salary, or the pay band minimum, whichever is the greater.

The individual will not retain any allowances paid by the former department/Agency, unless there are special circumstances, such as a reserved right to those allowances on transfer.

Successful candidates may be subject to annual Occupational Health reviews dependent on role requirements. If you have any queries, please contact careers@mhra.gov.uk.

  
  
  
  
Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview or assessment.

### **Security**

Successful candidates must undergo a basic (or equivalent) criminal record check.

People working with government assets must complete baseline personnel security standard (opens in new window) checks.

* nationals of the Republic of Ireland
* nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
* nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
* nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)

Further information on nationality requirements

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.
  
  
We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles .

The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria.

The Civil Service also offers a Redeployment Interview Scheme to civil servants who are at risk of redundancy, and who meet the minimum requirements for the advertised vacancy.

### **Diversity and Inclusion**

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy .

title: Senior .NET Engineer - Partner Integrations
description:
**Who we are**

We're Go.Compare, part of Future PLC. You've probably heard of us - we're a price comparison site passionate about finding our customers savvy insurance deals. We're a part of Future PLC and as one of the 250+ brands within Future publishing, we embody all the Future values.

We pride ourselves on being a fun but fair place to work, with flexible hours and plenty of perks, thanks to the Future community teams' hard work making sure each team member is treated equally. We only collaborate with organisations we can rely on, so we've built up a huge network of trusted partners. We're also authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

**The Team You’ll Join**

The Partner Integration Newbuilds team drives the onboarding of core Car/Van and Home insurance revenue generating brands on Go.Compare. Made up of two Senior Engineers, two Mid-Level Engineers, and an Integration Manager—working in tight alignment with dedicated QA—the team takes new partner integrations through complex, multi-disciplinary build phases.

Operating in a collaborative virtual office environment, team members rally around real-time problem solving, cross-functional teamwork, and a strong collective focus on shipping high-impact builds and delivering results together

**What you'll do**

As our Senior Software Engineer, you'll lead technical execution and full lifecycle ownership for partner integrations. Reporting to the Integrations Manager, you'll collaborate with external partners, lead developers, and compliance teams to design high-performance REST APIs. You'll oversee code releases, refine development processes, and advocate for Test-Driven Development (TDD) across our SDLC. You'll also leverage modern AI tools like Copilot and Claude to accelerate integration testing and debugging within FCA-regulated environments.

In this role, you'll provide high-level architectural guidance and conduct code reviews to ensure scalability, security, and maintainability. You'll translate complex technical hurdles into clear insights for executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. As a technical mentor, you'll support team growth, guide deployment strategies, and maintain clear communication during critical system alignment. Your technical leadership ensures our integration platform remains robust, elegant, and secure.

* Lead and mentor engineering team members through architectural guidance and thorough code reviews.
* Design, build, and maintain high-performance REST APIs for data formats like XML, JSON, and SOAP.
* Manage end-to-end partner integration lifecycles from initial discovery to live, zero-downtime deployment.
* Partner with legal and compliance teams to ensure all solutions align with FCA security standards.
* Refine internal development processes, champion TDD principles, and optimize the overall SDLC.
* Utilize AI-assisted tools like Copilot and Claude to streamline debugging and integration testing.

**What you’ll bring**

* Senior-Level Expertise: Extensive experience in software engineering with a proven track record of leading high-impact projects and cross-functional teams.
* Tech Stack Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in C# and SQL Server. Deep experience with RESTful design and handling legacy protocols like SOAP.
* Process Leadership: Demonstrated ability to design and implement development workflows (e.g., CI/CD improvements, branching strategies, or agile ceremonies).
* Release Governance: Practical experience managing production deployments and overseeing the "Definition of Done."
* Mentorship: A passion for growing others, with experience in formal code reviews and career coaching for junior and mid-level developers.
* Testing Rigor: A "test-first" mindset with experience implementing TDD at a team-wide level

**What we offer**

* Uncapped leave
* Enhanced parental leave
* Discounted rates with Dental care and Private Medical care
* When we hit our targets, enjoy a share of our profits with a bonus
* Refer a friend scheme - with payment following the successful hire.
* Well-being support with access to our Colleague Assistant Programmes
* Opportunity to purchase shares in Future, with our Share Incentive Plan
* Salary sacrifice Pension scheme up to 5% match
* Free drinks and snacks in our offices

The expected range for this role is £50,000 - £60,000

This is a hybrid role, working two days per week from our Cardiff office.

Internal job family level Technology 5

**Inclusion and Diversity at Future**  
At Future, we’re working to attract, retain and foster diverse talent, educating our colleagues in the importance of diversity, and review our internal processes so that they remain as free from bias as possible. We recognise that, in order to reach diverse communities through our content, we must first ensure ours is a culture in which diversity can thrive.

Find out more about Our Future, Our Responsibility on our website.

If you need any reasonable adjustments, please let us know, and we'll be happy to support you.

title: Software Engineering (Graduate & Internship Opportunites)
description:
**Company Overview**

Alloyed is a young venture-funded company of about 300 world-class metallurgists, engineers, and software developers working across the UK, Japan and the US to build the future of advanced metal components and systems. To do this, Alloyed uses proprietary software packages which combine advanced machine learning and physical modelling to invent better alloys, devise better ways to process them, and design better 3D-printed components and assemblies.

Alloyed is composed of a range of divisions, enabling metal technology from composition to systems:

* **Core Technology:** Alloyed's internal research and technology hub, focused on creating the new alloys, manufacturing methods, digital tools and intellectual property that will power the company's future products and capabilities.
* **Innovation Services:** Work directly with customers to develop, optimise and qualify materials and manufacturing processes for demanding aerospace, defence, energy and industrial applications.
* **Component Engineering:** Design, manufacture and validate production-ready components, turning material and process innovations into high-performance hardware for customer applications.
* **Argive:** Develop and manufacture complete microturbine engine systems under ambitious timelines and customer expectations, enabled by Alloyed’s software stack, proprietary Alloys and AM processing capabilities.

Whether you're a recent graduate or a current university student, we offer exciting opportunities to gain real-world engineering experience at Alloyed.

* **Graduate Engineers**: Full-time positions for graduates ready to launch their careers on or before September 2027.
* **Summer Internships**: 8-week placements for students looking to apply their learning in an industry environment starting in July 2027.

**Role Overview**

We're looking for bright, curious candidates to join Alloyed's Software Engineering team. We like solving difficult problems and building software properly before rounding off the day with a little table tennis.

You'll work on production software at the intersection of cloud technology, data and advanced manufacturing. Our platforms support engineers throughout the product lifecycle, from design and process development to manufacturing, inspection and qualification.

No two weeks are the same. You might create a new web application, build a .NET service, work with SQL databases or design an API. You'll gain hands-on experience with modern software development practices, including automated testing, code review, containerised applications, CI/CD and cloud deployment.

You'll work closely with software engineers, materials scientists and process engineers to build real products from week one. That could mean understanding a user problem, designing and building a new feature, testing it with engineers, or supporting its release into production.

* Design, develop, deploy and maintain Alloyed’s software platforms for: Data management / Traceability / Visualisation and analysis / Process optimisation

* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from understanding user requirements and generating user stories through to development, testing and release.
* Work collaboratively to solve complex technical and engineering problems.
* Translate specialised engineering knowledge and workflows into intuitive, reliable software.
* Integrate machine-learning models into production software for performance prediction and process optimisation.
* Contribute to the ongoing improvement of our software architecture, development practices and engineering standards.

* A strong technical background, demonstrated through a completed or expected degree in a quantitative subject such as computer science, engineering, mathematics or the physical sciences (2:1 minimum).

* Experience writing software in at least one object-oriented programming language through academic, personal or professional projects, for example C#, C++, Java, Python or Go.

* An interest in applied engineering or science.

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.

* Experience with version control systems, such as Git.

* Understanding of data structures and algorithms.

**Desired skills**

* Good understanding of software design patterns, best practices and principles, e.g. DRY.

* Familiarity with test-driven development.

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines.

* Understanding of concurrent programming principles.

* Experience programming with 3D geometry.

* Experience developing or integrating machine-learning models.

**Technology Stack:**

* Backend: C# | C++ | ASP.NET Core | EF Core | GraphQL | REST
* Frontend: Blazor | Next.js | React | TypeScript
* Data: Microsoft SQL Server
* Cloud & DevOps: Azure | Azure DevOps | Docker
* AI: Azure AI Foundry

title: QA Engineer (Product Engineering Team)
description:
**Location:** Cardiff

Hybrid/Flexible Working

**Salary:** Up to £45,000 depending on experience, plus a potential bonus of up to £9,000

**The Role**

You'll join the Engineering team at LDMS as a QA Engineer, working within a team and reporting to an Engineering Team Lead. You'll own the testing approach for the features your team delivers, from requirement review through to production sign-off, and you'll build the automation that keeps that coverage running.

Our stack is React and TypeScript on the frontend, Java with Spring Boot on the backend, and PostgreSQL with schema-per-tenant multi-tenancy underneath, all cloud-hosted on AWS. Test automation is WebdriverIO and Playwright, running in CI.

You'll work within the test strategy and standards set for your team and feed into them where you see a better approach. You'll be trusted to decide how a feature gets tested, to say when something is not ready, and to keep testing moving when the requirements are still unclear. Supporting junior QAs is part of the job.

**Key Responsibilities**

These may change with the needs of the business, but the main areas are:

**Technical Skills**

* Design and build automation for your feature areas across UI, API and integration layers with minimal oversight
* Spot testability gaps in technical designs and raise them during planning and design review, before they get expensive to fix
* Build performance tests for key user journeys and interpret the results against a baseline
* Choose the right test approach for the risk in front of you, whether risk-based, exploratory or scripted, and explain the trade-offs
* Keep tests reliable, fast and independent, including the test data they depend on

**Delivery**

* Plan and own the testing approach for end-to-end feature delivery, managing test scope and raising risks early
* Pull out dependencies and unknowns in acceptance criteria before engineering has started
* Own quality sign-off through to production, then watch defect trends after release and act on regressions
* Give reliable test estimates at story level and flag slippage early rather than late
* Keep testing moving when requirements are ambiguous, while chasing the clarity you need

**Impact**

* Contribute consistently to your team's quality goals, to the point where release confidence depends on your work
* Help graduate and junior QAs get better through informal mentoring on test design, automation patterns and defect writing
* Raise QA process improvements and follow them through when you take ownership
* Represent the quality view in cross-functional conversations and explain trade-offs to people without a testing background

**Communication**

* Adapt how you communicate to the audience, with detailed defect analysis for engineers and clear risk summaries for product and stakeholders
* Contribute from a quality angle in design and feature reviews
* Give specific, useful feedback on test coverage and code quality in review
* Raise quality concerns directly and professionally, and never let a known risk go unreported
* Write test documentation other people can pick up and run without coming back to you

**AI and Innovation**

* Use AI to broaden test design, including boundary values, negative paths and data permutations, and judge which suggestions are real risks and which are noise
* Review AI-generated test code for reliability and maintainability, and reject tests that pass without meaningfully exercising the system
* Follow the team's agreed approach to AI-assisted work, and keep the rules and skills for your test area current as things change
* Take responsibility for what carries your name and what you commit to, whatever helped produce it

**Requirements**

**Essential**

* Solid hands-on software testing experience across both manual and automated testing
* Hands-on automation experience with WebdriverIO or Playwright, and comfortable picking up the other
* Experience implementing automated tests using Cucumber or another BDD framework
* Working knowledge of Java or JavaScript/TypeScript, enough to write and maintain test code that others review
* Strong SQL, and comfortable querying relational databases directly
* API testing experience and a sound understanding of request and response cycles
* Comfortable with Git, and with tests running in a CI/CD pipeline (for example Jenkins)
* A track record of owning testing for a feature end to end, including the sign-off decision
* Able to make progress when requirements are incomplete, while chasing the clarity you need
* Clear communicator in writing and in person, with defect reports and risk summaries that people can act on

**Desirable**

* Performance testing experience, including interpreting results against a baseline
* Non-functional test coverage such as accessibility checks or security scanning
* Experience using AI tools well as part of day-to-day testing
* An understanding of what it takes to build and test software in a financial environment
* Experience with cloud-hosted systems on AWS
* Test data management in a multi-tenant environment
* Experience supporting or mentoring graduate and junior testers

LDMS are pioneers of credit software, with a 20 year history of delivering state-of-the-art loan management solutions across EMEA. Our platform has powered the formidable growth of LC Financial Holdings, now managing over €60bn in assets across 10 countries and over 7 million customer accounts.

LDMS supports multi-jurisdictional, language and currency; our processes and products ensure maximum flexibility and empower every single user to be more effective, with surety of regulatory compliance. The best technology provides a true business advantage. Based in our Cardiff tech hub, we have a 80-strong team of highly experienced engineers providing full professional services implementation support by dedicated experts.

**LDMS**  
11 Belgrave Road, London, England, SW1V 1RB

* Strong React and TypeScript fundamentals, including component composition, state management and typing that holds up under review

* Experience working within a design system or established component library, including extending it properly rather than forking it
* You can take a UI idea, whether a sketch, a design file or a conversation, and turn it into something buildable
* You care about the detail. Not just whether it works, but whether it feels right. You take pride in UI and UX that is genuinely good
* Solid across unit, integration and end-to-end testing, for example Vitest, WebdriverIO or Playwright
* Comfortable with Git, and with builds and tests running in a CI/CD pipeline such as Jenkins
* Able to make progress when requirements or designs are incomplete, while chasing the clarity you need
* Clear communicator in writing and in person, with updates and technical explanations that people can act on

**Desirable**

* Accessibility experience, including working to WCAG standards

* Experience with Docker or other containerisation tools
* Experience with cloud-hosted systems on AWS

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Developer who loves building seamless, high-quality user experiences and has an eye for detail. You’ll play a key role in creating the next generation of our digital products, shaping how thousands of customers interact with our services every day.
  
You’ll have the freedom to lead on technical decisions, the support to grow, and the chance to mentor others. We believe learning and sharing knowledge is what makes a team truly exceptional.
  
We work together in our Liverpool HQ three days a week because collaboration, creativity and quick feedback make for better products and a stronger team.
  
  
**Role:** Senior Frontend Developer
  
**Location:** Liverpool City Centre HQ / Hybrid (3 days in office)\*\*
  
**Salary:** £65,000–£75,000 depending on experience
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**  

* Design and develop modern, responsive web applications using React, Next.js and TypeScript
* Build scalable, reusable frontend components with clean, maintainable code
* Work closely with designers who are part of your squad to bring ideas from concept to polished experiences
* Optimise for performance, accessibility and security
* Use Sentry and PostHog to monitor, measure and improve frontend performance
* Collaborate with backend engineers and product owners in an agile environment
* Mentor other developers and help shape our frontend standards and practices
* Share feedback, suggest improvements and help the team continuously level up

**Our Tech Stack:**  
**Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript
  
**Infrastructure:** Nginx, Docker, Azure
  
**Monitoring and Analytics:** Sentry, PostHog
  
**Tooling:** Git, CI/CD pipelines, Agile methodologies
  
Experience with React Native is a bonus as we continue expanding our digital products into mobile.
  
  
**Engineering Practices:**  
We take craftsmanship seriously and believe great products start with great engineering.
  

* Modern CI/CD pipelines for fast, reliable deployments
* Testing, code reviews and maintainable architecture are part of our everyday practice
* Focus on performance, accessibility and clean design patterns
* Monitoring and observability with Sentry, PostHog and Grafana for insight into user experience and system health
* A culture of experimentation, learning and continuous improvement

**What We’re Looking For:**  

* Proven experience building production-ready frontend applications
* Strong expertise in React, Next.js and TypeScript
* A solid understanding of frontend architecture, performance and security best practices
* Experience with Docker and Azure deployments
* A collaborative mindset and strong communication skills
* A passion for creating user-focused, beautifully crafted digital experiences
* Experience mentoring others and helping teams improve their craft

**Nice to Have:**

* Knowledge of modern state management such as Redux or Zustand
* Understanding of accessibility standards and WCAG guidelines

Why Join Us
  

* Modern tech stack and a strong culture of engineering excellence
* Work closely with designers and product owners to shape the user experience

* Supportive environment with clear standards and room to innovate
* Top-tier tools and a workspace designed for creativity and collaboration

Team and Culture
  
You’ll join a squad that genuinely enjoys working together. Designers, engineers and product thinkers sit side by side, sharing ideas and solving problems as a team.
  
We believe in ownership, curiosity and craftsmanship. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage ideas from across the squad. We share knowledge, celebrate success and support each other every step of the way.
  
If you care about building great products and growing as part of a collaborative, design-led team, you’ll fit right in.
  
  
Grow with Acorn
  
  
At Acorn Insurance, we’re proud of our Liverpool roots — and even prouder of how far we’ve come. As part of the Acorn Group, we bring over 40 years of specialist insurance expertise to the table. From humble beginnings, we’ve grown into a national leader, now employing 1,700+ people across the UK and reached a milestone £750 million in total value of insurance policies written in 2024.
  
  
We’re growing fast, with new opportunities emerging every week. That growth is largely due to the values we share:
  
  

* We run through walls for our customers and each other
* We challenge the status quo
* We succeed when we help those around us succeed
* We decide quickly when the smart thing to do is use our judgement

**Benefits:**  

* A maximum of 35 days’ holiday (depending on role and tenure) including bank holidays, with additional buy/sell options
* 24/7 mental health support & free counselling available
* Grow with us: Through career fairs, leadership programs, and learning on the go!
* Flexible benefits, including early access to salary via our internal platform
* Hybrid working options to support work-life balance and individual needs
* Recognition awards, social events & more

**Our Commitment to our colleague’s:**  
These aren’t just words — they’re the principles we live by. And we’re proud to back them up with real action, earning recognition and accreditation from leading organisations that share our commitment to people and growth:
  
  

* Mindful Employer – championing mental health and wellbeing
* Disability Confident Level 1 & 2 – creating accessible, inclusive opportunities
* Menopause Friendly accredited – supporting every stage of life
* ️ Armed Forces Covenant signatory – honouring those who serve
* ️ Armed Forces Defence employer recognition scheme - Supporting those who serve
* Great Places to Work 2024/25 – fostering an engaging and positive workplace culture
* Best Place to Work for Development – proud to be investing in people’s future

If you’re looking for a company with a strong culture, real career progression, and a people-first approach — all rooted in the heart of Liverpool — Grow with Acorn.
  
  
A Few Things to Know Before You Apply
  
  
We’re really excited that you’re considering joining Acorn! To help everything go smoothly, here are a couple of things to keep in mind:
  
  
If your application is successful, we will commence relevant employment checks prior to you commencing employment with us. These will include a standard criminal record check and an insolvency register check.

title: Backend Engineering Team Lead
description:
**About Netcraft**

Netcraft is the global leader in cybercrime detection and disruption. We're a trusted partner for three of the four largest companies in the world and many large governments. We've blocked over 225 million cyber-attacks to date, and we take down around 33% of the world's phishing attacks.

Our purpose and passion are focused on just one thing: protecting the world from cybercrime.

That passion shapes how we work, too. We're proud of our talented team and the value each person brings, and we've built a workplace where people feel supported and inspired. From strong benefits and wellness programs to meaningful collaboration and team connection.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Backend Engineering Team Lead to establish and lead a new backend team responsible for several key Netcraft products, including:

* The **Integration Layer**, which enables customers to integrate their SIEM platforms with Netcraft data
* **NSI**, which supports engagement with criminals conducting conversational scams at scale
* The **Web and SSL Server Survey**
* **Spam**, which analyses emails from multiple sources to identify phishing and scam activity

These products are a mixture of legacy platforms that produce key data supporting Netcraft systems and new products that support our customer base. You'll be a technical leader with expertise across a varied stack, with the commercial acumen to understand how to modernise legacy products as well as commercialise new products.

You will build a new team to manage and improve these products, contributing code, demonstrating best practice, and managing an exciting delivery roadmap.

**You'll be:**

* Working with Product and Design colleagues to evaluate each of your products, determining where immediate improvements can be made and helping to develop the long-term strategy for each
* Operating with autonomy, taking the initiative to solve problems and recognising the importance of adhering to demanding delivery timelines
* Managing requirements from key stakeholders and customers, understanding what needs to be done based on business needs without necessarily needing to be told
* Prioritising, refining, and sequencing the team's workflow while retaining approximately **30–50% of your time for hands-on engineering**
* Deeply embedded in conceiving and executing engineering solutions, creating performant systems and services to delight our customers
* Upholding high engineering standards with a demonstrable commitment to code quality, a test-driven approach, and a modern continuous integration/continuous deployment delivery flow
* Well-versed in how AI-first development techniques can materially boost productivity
* Responsible for building and leading a high-performing team of talented and enthusiastic engineers

**What You'll Need to Be Successful**

* Strong and demonstrable leadership skills, with a constructive attitude to problem-solving and the ability to switch effectively between priorities
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to distil technical concepts for a range of stakeholders and motivate a team
* A strong engineering background spanning a range of technologies
* A demonstrable track record of identifying opportunities to create significant value within existing products and taking ideas from concept through to production
* Experience partnering closely with Product Managers and Product Owners to shape product strategy, define priorities, and translate customer and business needs into effective technical solutions
* Experience working with AWS technologies and a range of machine learning tools and frameworks
* An interest in reverse-engineering codebases, where necessary, to understand the inner workings of legacy products
* Experience interviewing and hiring engineers, building effective teams, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement

**Bonus Points If You Have:**

* Strong Go development skills, particularly in technology modernisation or uplift projects. OpenSearch, MongoDB, and Perl experience considered an advantage.
* Experience with generative AI technologies and where and how to apply them to improve customer experiences
* Practical experience managing engineers at different career stages, from recent graduates to seasoned professionals

**The Rewards Package**

* 33 days annual leave - includes public holidays which can be worked if you prefer
* Generous enhanced family leave and pay
* Enhanced company sick pay from day one of employment, with additional support after your first six months' service
* Salary sacrifice pension with matched employer contributions up to 5% + NI savings
* Private health cover, including access to a private GP service
* Life Assurance at 4 x salary
* Equity tracking scheme (eligibility criteria apply) - allowing you share in Netcraft's long term success
* Hybrid and flexible working options
* Meals, snacks, and drinks provided in the office
* Comprehensive health, safety, and wellness service available 24/7 for you and your family
* Two paid Learning & Development days per year plus access to learning resources such as Udemy and Coursera to support your career
* Two Volunteering Days per year, to allow you to contribute to your wider community or charity
* Employee Referral Bonus scheme
* Spot reward bonus scheme to reward truly outstanding contributions

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**

This is deeply important to us. Through our ally network, we support under-represented groups and maintain a working environment free from bias, harassment, or discrimination. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

We're also happy to make adjustments to the hiring process to ensure every candidate can participate fully.

**Please note:** Netcraft does not accept unsolicited approaches from external recruiters.

title: Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
**Why Ryan?**

* Competitive Compensation and Benefits
* Business Connectivity Reimbursement (Phone/Internet)
* Gym Membership or Equipment Reimbursement
* LinkedIn Learning Subscription
* Flexible Work Environment
* Tuition Reimbursement After One Year of Service
* Accelerated Career Path
* Award-Winning Culture & Community Outreach

  
The Full Stack AI Engineer is an early-career software engineering role focused on building and delivering full-stack applications with generative AI and agentic capabilities embedded into the solution architecture.  
  
The role is designed for high-potential graduates and engineers with up to three years of experience who combine strong software engineering fundamentals with a different way of thinking about how AI can reshape enterprise workflows and applications.  
  
This is not a traditional machine learning or data science role, and it is not about adding AI for AI's sake. The focus is on understanding business problems end to end and determining where large language models, agents, and AI-enabled workflows can materially improve how work gets done.  
  
Working as part of a fully functioning engineering team, the Full Stack AI Engineer contributes across the delivery lifecycle, from understanding the problem and shaping the solution through development, deployment, and iteration.  
  
Success in this role means writing high-quality code, learning quickly, contributing effectively within a team, and developing the judgment to build AI-enabled software that creates measurable value for clients and the business.

**Duties and responsibilities, as they align to Ryan’s Key Results**

This role operates in Ryan’s results-oriented and flexible culture, with a strong emphasis on engineering quality, ownership, and measurable outcomes.

Engineers are trusted to choose appropriate tools, approaches, and AI-assisted workflows rather than follow heavy development processes. That autonomy is paired with clear accountability for the quality, reliability, and business impact of what they deliver.

The role is intended for engineers early in their careers. Success is not measured by years of experience or by knowledge of a particular AI framework. It is measured by strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility, quality of thinking, and the ability to contribute working code to AI-enabled solutions.

Active mentorship and structured opportunities for growth support continued development in both software engineering and applied AI.

**People:**

* Works as part of a cross-functional engineering team to design, build, and improve AI-enabled full-stack software.
* Collaborates effectively with engineers, business professionals, and end users to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions.
* Participates in client-facing conversations where appropriate, communicating technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Learns from more experienced team members and contributes knowledge, ideas, and emerging best practices back into the team.
* Uses feedback constructively and demonstrates strong learning agility in a rapidly evolving technical environment.

**Client:**

* Works with business professionals and customers to understand problems, workflows, and opportunities for improvement.
* Helps determine where generative AI or agentic approaches can create meaningful value, rather than applying AI where traditional software would be more appropriate.
* Contributes to the end-to-end delivery of AI-enabled applications, including discovery, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and iteration.  
  Builds full-stack applications that may incorporate large language models, agent-based workflows, retrieval, APIs, and other AI capabilities as part of the overall architecture.
* Supports the deployment and adoption of solutions used by real users in business and client environments.
* Considers the complete enterprise workflow when designing solutions, including users, data, integrations, business rules, human oversight, and failure scenarios.

**Value:**

* Writes high-quality, maintainable code that contributes to dependable software used by real users.
* Applies AI where it materially improves a process, user experience, decision, or business outcome.
* Thinks critically about when an agentic solution is appropriate and when deterministic software is the better choice.
* Contributes to solutions that address real-world problems and generate measurable value for clients and the business.
* Iterates on deployed applications based on user feedback, performance, reliability, and adoption.
* Balances speed, scope, and engineering quality to support effective delivery.
* Makes effective use of AI-assisted coding tools while maintaining ownership and understanding of the code produced.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Suitable for recent graduates and candidates with approximately 0-3 years of professional software engineering experience.
* Strong foundation in software engineering, demonstrated through professional work, internships, university projects, personal projects, open-source contributions, hackathons, or equivalent technical experience.
* Evidence of interest in and hands-on exploration of generative AI, large language models, or agentic systems.
* Commercial generative AI experience is not required.
* Ability to explain technical decisions, trade-offs, and personal contribution to projects in detail.
* Strong interest in understanding how AI can change enterprise workflows and software architecture, rather than simply adding AI features to existing applications.

**Computer Skills:**

We are largely framework-agnostic. What matters most is strong engineering fundamentals, the ability to learn quickly, and evidence that you can build useful software.

* Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Python, TypeScript, or JavaScript.
* Experience building full-stack applications through professional work, internships, academic projects, or independent development.
* Strong understanding of core software engineering concepts, including APIs, databases, Git, testing, debugging, and application architecture.
* Familiarity with frontend and backend development using technologies such as React, Node/TypeScript, Python/FastAPI, or similar.
* Conceptual understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP; hands-on deployment experience is beneficial but not required.
* Exposure to generative AI application development, including LLM APIs, agentic workflows, retrieval, vector databases, or agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or AutoGen.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar, with the ability to validate and understand AI-generated code.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Interoperability)
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Interoperability)

Posting Start Date: 08/09/2026

Job Id: 3076

School/Department: Advanced Manufacturing Research Centre

Work Arrangement: Full Time (Hybrid)

Contract Type: Fixed-term

Salary per annum (£): £38,784.00 - £47,389.00

Closing Date: 06/10/2026

The University of Sheffield is a remarkable place to work. Our people are at the heart of everything we do. Their diverse backgrounds, abilities and beliefs make Sheffield a world-class university.

We offer a fantastic range of benefits including a highly competitive annual leave entitlement (with the ability to purchase more), a generous pensions scheme, flexible working opportunities, a commitment to your development and wellbeing, a wide range of retail discounts, and much more.

**Overview**

Are you a skilled software engineer who loves solving complex integration challenges and building seamless system architectures? We have an exciting opportunity for you to join us as a Senior Software Engineer and lead the development of our core interoperability infrastructure.

  

You will join the AMRC at the University of Sheffield, as part of a growing interoperability team currently funded by a UKRI Future Leadership Fellow. We are tackling critical system interoperability barriers preventing organisations from leveraging leading-edge technology, such as digital twins and AI, by unifying the current siloed infrastructures. While the wider project focuses on accelerating industrial interoperability approaches, **this role is dedicated entirely to the core software infrastructure that underpins it.**

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead the development of robust, cross-cutting software architectures that allow disparate systems, datasets, and platforms to communicate seamlessly. With 2-3 years of software engineering experience, you will collaborate with industry partners, and end-user stakeholders to build the integration layers, APIs, and data pipelines necessary to deliver structured, reusable data outputs.

Please submit a CV and cover letter. In your cover letter, please include:

* A link to or description of a software system or integration you have architected (e.g., a technical design prose, a GitHub repository with clear documentation, or explained API specification).

* A brief account of a specific challenge you faced when integrating two or more disparate systems, including the technical approach you took and how you overcame it.

* A short description of a cross-functional collaboration where you translated connectivity or data requirements from non-technical stakeholders into a working technical solution.

  
  

**Main duties and responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and implement software pipelines, APIs and middleware to ensure seamless communication between disparate systems, databases, and research tools.
* Build and manage data pipelines and orchestration layers (e.g. containerisation and microservices) that govern how information moves between systems, ensuring reliability and data integrity.
* Architect pragmatic solutions to connect and extract data from legacy manufacturing systems, enabling their transformation into a modern digital ecosystem.
* Evaluate existing infrastructure and recommend architectural improvements, protocols, and communication standards (e.g., REST, MQTT, GraphQL, SPARQL).
* Write clean, maintainable, and scalable software solutions to support integration projects, transitioning proof-of-concept scripts into robust backend services, including management of open-source repositories.
* Champion modern software engineering practices within the team, including version control, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Produce detailed and accurate technical documentation, including system architecture diagrams, API specifications, and data flow maps.
* Work closely with project engineers, researchers, and shop floor staff to understand their workflows and translate their connectivity needs into technical requirements.
* Lead technical project meetings and maintain strong communication channels with collaborators and partners.
* Make ethical and sustainable technical decisions, embedding the organisation's sustainability strategy into your working activities wherever possible.
* Carry out other duties, commensurate with the grade and remit of the post

**Person Specification**

Our diverse community of staff and students recognises the unique abilities, backgrounds, and beliefs of all. We foster a culture where everyone feels they belong and are respected. Even if your past experience doesn't match perfectly with this role's criteria, your contribution is valuable, and we encourage you to apply. Please ensure that you reference the application criteria in the application statement when you apply.

  

**Criteria**

**Essential or desirable**

**Stage(s) assessed at**

  

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related area, coupled with 2-3 years of practical software engineering experience.

**Essential**

Interview / Application

  

Proficiency in one or more languages used in data integration and backend development (e.g., Python, Java, or equivalent), with a portfolio of relevant work developed collaboratively with source control (e.g. Git).

**Essential**

Interview / Application

  

Proven track record in designing and implementing interoperable software systems, APIs (e.g., REST, GraphQL, OpenAPI), message brokers, and robust data integration pipelines utilising standard data exchange formats (e.g. JSON, XML).

**Essential**

Interview / Application

  

Advanced familiarity with reproducible software development, including rigorous testing (unit/integration), comprehensive documentation, CI/CD, and version control.

**Essential**

Interview / Application

  

Solid practical skills in software architecture, system design, and database management.

**Essential**

Interview / Application

  

Experience with containerisation and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) for deploying and managing interoperable microservices, including proficiency in terminal scripting environments (e.g. Linux, Bash) and maintaining software in live production environments.

**Essential**

Interview / Application

  

Understanding of security best practices for API and data pipeline design, including authentication, authorisation, and input validation.

**Essential**

Interview / Application

  

Ability to work in an interdisciplinary environment and collaborate with researchers to translate their requirements into scalable, interoperable software solutions.

**Essential**

Interview / Application

  

Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, including the ability to write high-quality technical/API documentation and system architecture reports.

**Essential**

Interview / Application

  

Ability to work effectively as part of an agile team (e.g. scrum, kanban) with a demonstrated capacity to operate independently, alongside excellent time, project management, and collaborative skills.

**Essential**

Interview / Application

  

Experience working within manufacturing, engineering, or IoT sectors, or familiarity with industrial communication protocols (MQTT, OPC-UA).

**Desirable**

Interview / Application

  

Familiarity with semantic web technologies (RDF, SPARQL), linked data principles, or large language model (LLM) APIs and agentic frameworks for automated data integration.

**Desirable**

Interview / Application

**Further Information**

**Grade**

7

  

**Salary**

£38,784 - £47,289 per annum.

  

**Work arrangement**

Full-time

  

**Duration**

Fixed Term until 31st October 2029

  

**Line manager**

Senior Technical Fellow in Interoperability

  

**Direct reports**

None - with opportunity for supporting placements and graduate staff.

  

**Right to work in the UK**

If you do not currently hold the right to work in the UK, you can find more information here to help determine your visa eligibility. Additional guidance is also available on the UK Visa & Immigration website.

  

For informal enquiries about this job contact Jonathan Eyre, Senior Technical Fellow in Interoperability on j.eyre@amrc.co.uk

We are committed to exploring flexible working opportunities which benefit the individual and University.

  

**Next steps in the recruitment process**

The selection process will consist of an in-person interview at Factory 2050, Sheffield consisting of: a short presentation from applicants, a series of questions from a panel, followed by a tour around the facility. We plan to let candidates know if they have progressed to the selection stage within two weeks of the closing date. Contact Jonathan Eyre if you require any reasonable adjustments.

  

**Our vision and strategic plan**

We are the University of Sheffield. This is our vision: sheffield.ac.uk/vision ().

**What we offer**

* A minimum of 41days annual leave including bank holiday and closure days (pro rata) with the ability to purchase more.
* Flexible working opportunities, including hybrid working for some roles.
* Generous pension scheme.
* A wide range of discounts and rewards on shopping, eating out and travel.
* A variety of staff networks, providing opportunities for social interaction, peer support and personal development (for example, Race Equality, LGBT+, Women’s and Parent’s networks).
* Recognition Awards to reward staff who go above and beyond in their role.
* A commitment to your development access to learning and mentoring schemes; integrated with our Academic Career Pathways / Professional Services Shared Skills Framework.
* A range of generous family-friendly policies

  + paid time off for parenting and caring emergencies
  + access to menopause support in the workplace
  + paid time off and support for fertility treatment
  + and more

  

We are a Disability Confident Leader (opens in a new window). If you have a disability and meet the essential criteria for this job you will be invited to take part in the next stage of the selection process.

  

**Criminal record**

Possession of a criminal record is not an automatic bar to employment at the University of Sheffield. We recognise the value of steady employment in the rehabilitation process and examine each case in its own right. More information can be found on our Information for candidates page.

  
  
  

**Baseline personnel security standard**

This role requires the postholder to undertake a Government baseline personnel security standard (BPSS) check as a condition of employment.

We are a research university with a global reputation for excellence. Our ideas and expertise change the world for the better, making a real difference to society. We know that when people come together with different views, approaches and insights it can lead to richer, more creative and innovative teaching and research and the highest levels of student experience. Our University Vision (www.sheffield.ac.uk/vision) outlines our commitment to building a diverse community of staff and students that recognises and values the abilities, backgrounds, beliefs and ways of living for everyone.

title: Data Center Technician Intern, 2027
description:
Applications for this role will open on October 5, 2026.

Please complete your application before **November 13, 2026**. We encourage you to apply as early as possible as we review applications on a rolling basis.

This internship is intended for students enrolled in an educational program relevant to the job qualifications or those in the penultimate/final year of an accredited full-time Bachelor's or Master's degree program located in the EMEA region. Participation in the internship program requires that you are located in the UK for the duration of the internship program. Interns will be required to be available to work full-time for a minimum of 13 weeks over the Summer 2027 (starting in May, June or July) for the duration of the program. Individuals applying for this position will not be eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Timing on when you can hear back will vary and can take upwards of 90+ days. If you haven’t heard from us in three months about an application, we likely proceeded with other candidates for that particular role. However, our recruiters might reach out if we find a different potential match for your skills, interests, and experience.

To start the application process, you will need an updated CV or resume, and for Bachelor's and Master's students a current unofficial or official transcript in English. Click on the “Apply” button on this page and provide the required materials in the appropriate sections (PDFs preferred):

* In the “Resume Section:” attach an updated CV or resume
* In the “Education Section:” attach a current or recent unofficial or official transcript in English.
* Under “Degree Status,” select “Now attending” to upload a transcript.

Please include your expected graduation date (month and year), and availability for the internship on your resume. The specific team and project(s) will be determined based on your educational background, interest and skills.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Currently enrolled in an educational program relevant to the job qualifications or an accredited full-time Bachelor's or Master's degree program located in the EMEA region.
* Relevant practical or internship experience in diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems, computer/server hardware, or networking protocols.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Relevant practical to internship experience performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on IT equipment or in a similar role (e.g. Systems Administration, Network Deployment Engineer, Help Desk Technician, etc).
* Relevant practical to internship experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.

title: Software Engineering Summer Intern
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

Applications for this position will be accepted from 2 October through 16 October. We encourage interested candidates to apply early to ensure full consideration.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of software development principles, methodologies, and best practices
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency
* Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build and maintain professional relationships with stakeholders at all levels
* Collaborative team player with a proactive and positive approach
* Highly organized, efficient, and results-oriented
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

**Education**

* Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or related field
* Ability to work during program dates: June 14 - August 20, 2027

**Responsibilities**

Develop and enhance fund finance API solutions through software development, test automation, documentation, and stakeholder engagement.

* Assist in the ongoing development of AM Fund Finance suite of APIs
* Support the design and delivery of automated testing solutions to improve application quality and reliability
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation and supporting materials
* Contribute to the creation and delivery of internal and external presentations
* Collaborate with team members to support project delivery and continuous improvement initiatives

**About the Team**

Asset Management (AM), a division of Moody’s, provides intuitive, user-friendly risk analytics and reporting for the pensions and investment market. Through our award-winning, customizable risk management solutions, our clients can identify, evaluate and manage risk while effectively capitalizing on investment opportunities. The AM Fund Finance product suite delivers a flexible framework that provides extensive coverage of a wide range of investments to provide transparency into a portfolio’s exposure, risk and performance. Based in Edinburgh, the AM Fund Finance team is looking for a talented, motivated individual to join the software development department. This will be a hybrid internship with approximately 2 days per week in the office. You must be in Edinburgh for the duration of the internship.

Moody's 10-week summer internship program is a premier opportunity for students to immerse themselves in a hands-on learning experience, guided by Moody's commitment to integrity, excellence, and insight. The program takes place each summer from June – August and positions are available for undergraduate and select graduate students. Internships are full-time, offering a comprehensive view of Moody's business and culture, and a chance to build professional and technical skills. Programmatic elements include networking, mentorship, leadership speaker series and volunteering events. Interns complete project work determined by their team that have real impact, fostering a sense of accomplishment and professional growth. Throughout the internship, participants receive mentorship from Moody's professionals, gaining insights into diverse career paths and cultivate a comprehensive understanding of the company. Networking events and workshops further enrich the experience, providing a platform for professional development and collaboration. As a Moody's intern, you will gain real-world experience, turn inputs into actions, and be integral part of the team.

Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

Joining a collaborative culture with direct access to Google's engineering minds, you will act as an innovator-builder, providing white-glove deployment of complex AI systems and serving as a critical feedback loop to shape Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on massive scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, Social to Local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

description:
