--------------------------------------------------

Location: Telford

  

Intake: June 2027 for 8 weeks

**About the job you're considering**
------------------------------------

We are looking for individuals who are passionate about technology, innovation, and problem-solving, and who are eager to gain practical experience within the IT and consulting industry. You will be joining a team supporting one of our largest UK public sector clients, working alongside experienced professionals while building valuable skills, knowledge, and connections to support your future career.

During your internship, you will contribute to meaningful projects and gain exposure to real-world business challenges. You may support service delivery, project management, business operations, customer experience initiatives, or software engineering activities, depending on your chosen pathway. This may involve working on client-focused projects, supporting business operations, contributing to service improvement initiatives, or helping deliver innovative technology solutions. At Capgemini, we are helping shape a new age of intelligence, partnering with clients across industries to harness AI, technology, and human potential to drive meaningful change.

Working within multidisciplinary teams, you may be involved in collaborating with stakeholders to understand business requirements, supporting the delivery of projects and services, participating in planning and continuous improvement activities, building strong working relationships with clients and colleagues, analysing data to support decision-making, and exploring new technologies and innovative ways of working, including the use of Generative AI and other emerging digital tools.

  

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:
  
Identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

This role is only available to be based in our office in Telford. As such, you will need to be based within a commutable distance to your chosen office where you should expect to typically be in the office 3 days a week. This specific role is not available to be based in any other UK office; however, other opportunities on our website may offer greater flexibility on location.

**Your role**
-------------

As an Intern, no two days will be the same. You'll be working on live projects with a public sector client, gaining valuable insight into how technology and consulting services are delivered in a real-world environment. This is an opportunity to apply what you've learned at university while developing new skills, expanding your professional network, and learning from experienced professionals across a variety of disciplines.

To be eligible for this programme, you must:

• Be currently enrolled in the second year of a Bachelor's or Integrated Master's degree programme.
  
• Be intending to return to your studies following completion of the internship.
  
• Have strong communication and teamwork skills.
  
• Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn.
  
• Be eager to develop your understanding of technology, consulting, and business operations.

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment for everyone.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

Our Summer Internship Programme offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience within one of several exciting career pathways. Please indicate your preferred option during the application process.

  

As a **Service Analyst** Intern, you'll support the delivery and continuous improvement of live services, helping to monitor performance, engage with stakeholders, and identify opportunities to improve service delivery. As a **Business Operations** Intern, you'll gain exposure to governance, reporting, financial management, resource planning, and operational processes that support the successful running of a large client account. As a **PMO** Intern, you'll work alongside project teams to support planning, reporting, governance, risk management, and project delivery activities. Our **Customer Experience (CX)** Internship will provide exposure to activities focused on understanding user needs, improving customer journeys, and enhancing overall service experiences, with further details to be confirmed ahead of launch. As a **Software Engineering** Intern, you'll gain experience working within technical teams, supporting the development, testing, and maintenance of software solutions while learning modern engineering practices, development methodologies, and emerging technologies.

  

If you are seeking an exciting opportunity to gain real-world experience, learn from experienced professionals, and develop skills that will support your future career, then our Summer Internship Programme could be the perfect opportunity for you. You'll work in a collaborative environment, contribute to meaningful projects, and gain valuable insight into life at Capgemini whilst supporting a major UK public sector client.

**Graduate Development Experience**
-----------------------------------

Our graduate experience is designed to help you build the skills, mindset, and confidence to thrive in a rapidly evolving, AI-enabled world. From day one, you'll be part of a community focused on innovation, collaboration, and delivering accelerated solutions for our clients.

Through a combination of professional and technical development, client experience, and mentorship, you’ll develop the capabilities to solve complex challenges, innovate with confidence, and contribute from the very start of your career. Supercharge your development with access to our best-in-class content providers and technology partners including Harvard Business, Microsoft, OpenAI, and more.

Built around modules that encourage you to think creatively, embrace new technologies and turn ideas into meaningful impact. You’ll work alongside leaders and experts to build future-focused skills that prepare you for long-term success in technology, business, and consulting careers.

**We are a Disability Confident Employer**
------------------------------------------

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
  
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

- Declare they have a disability, and
  
- Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

**Your security clearance**
---------------------------

Security Check (SC) Clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

**Make it real – what does it mean for you?**
---------------------------------------------

Impactful Experiences

You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.

  

Shape your path

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

**Why you should consider Capgemini**
-------------------------------------

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

**About Capgemini**
-------------------

Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22.5 billion.

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

----------

**Based:** London, N7

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented QA Engineering Intern to join our Product team. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software and hardware testing for our audio products. * Assist in the development and execution of test plans and test cases for audio products, including hardware and software components.
* Conduct functional, performance, and regression testing on audio devices to identify defects and ensure product reliability.

* Participate in meetings and contribute to team discussions regarding quality initiatives and improvements.

**Qualifications:**

* Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Audio Engineering, or a related field.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently.
* Good communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team environment.
* Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Experience with programming or scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java) is a plus.

**What We Offer:**

* Hands-on experience in a fast-paced audio manufacturing environment.
* Mentorship from experienced engineers and product managers.
* Opportunity to work on innovative audio products and technology.
* Flexible work hours and a collaborative work environment.

TiMax are pioneers of the rapidly expanding sector of immersive sound experiences. We are focused on high-channel count, spatial audio sound reinforcement solutions for theatre, opera, musical theatre, live music events, festivals, corporate events and more!

Doing a 12-month placement at the Focusrite Group is like becoming one of the family. A rapidly growing, global family. We’re focused on providing opportunities for everyone and anyone to enjoy creating music.

description:
**Overview of Responsibilities**
--------------------------------

**About us**

Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them.

  

**About the job**

High-performance particle simulations targeting exascale computing will play a key part in the modelling of future fusion reactors, spanning a wide range of use cases, including plasma modelling, reacting gas flows, and particle-surface interactions.

The successful candidate for this role will primarily be working on the development of novel software and methods for performance-portable simulations based on the UKAEA particle library NESO-Particles. They will bring a combination of a good understanding of high-performance computing methods and tools, such as parallel and GPU programming, and knowledge of statistical and numerical methods for particle modelling (e.g. Particle-In-Cell, Direct Simulation Monte Carlo, etc.). This role is based in the Computing division at UKAEA, but a successful candidate would be expected to engage with colleagues across divisions (e.g. plasma physics), so basic knowledge of plasma physics and/or related disciplines is desirable, though not essential.

As well as working with peers on the development of high-performance simulation software, the role holder will assist with deploying and testing them on state-of-the-art systems like the SUNRISE supercomputer, which is soon to be stood up by UKAEA and Cambridge.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Technical:**

* Apply computational or numerical methods to scientific problems independently or as part of a team with oversight from senior computational scientists.
* Develop robust, maintainable software for use modelling aspects of tokamak plasmas.
* Ensure software meets user requirements, is well-tested and versioned and properly documented.
* Work with domain specialists to deploy computational models for research and development purposes.
* May advise colleagues on their area of expertise.

**Communication & Influencing:**

* Communicates technical concepts, methods, and results clearly and effectively to colleagues within and beyond their immediate team.
* Produces high‑quality technical reports, documentation, and contributions to journal publications, taking a leading role for outputs related to their work.
* Presents their work and that of their immediate team at organisational workshops.

**People Management:**

* May mentor junior team members (graduates and apprentices) on technical skills or supervise doctoral students.

**Organisational Knowledge:**

* Understands the context of their research within the wider landscape of fusion energy research. Computational scientists are expected to collaborate internally and externally with partners working in closely related areas.

**What You’ll Bring**

* A degree in a scientific, engineering, or technical subject + PhD or experience working in an academic or industrial research environment.
* Demonstrable experience in at least one modern programming language relevant to plasma modelling (C++, Fortran, Python, Julia)
* Familiarity with modern software engineering practices.
* Ability to write efficient, comprehensible and maintainable code independently.
* Familiarity with common numerical methods for simulation of relevant physical systems.
* Ability to learn and apply new technologies, communicate technical work clearly to diverse audiences, manage time effectively to meet project deadlines and quality standards, and work collaboratively while taking ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  

*UKAEA is an onsite organisation, and this role requires regular onsite presence (usually between 3-5 days in any given week) in line with business needs. We actively support flexible working arrangements where this is compatible with the role*.

  

**Benefits**

We have a generous range of benefits (see the full list here) and highlights include:

* A salary of £43,702(inclusive of a £3,300 specialist allowance)
* Up to 7% corporate performance bonus
* Final salary defined benefits pension scheme with an equivalent of 21.5% employer pension contribution
* 25 days annual leave plus 2.5 privilege days; 8 Bank Holidays
* 3 days of site closure over Christmas break

title: General Counsel (Office based)
description:
We are hiring a **General Counsel**, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.

This is a unique opportunity for an **exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer** to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution.

Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will **own Canonical's legal, regulatory and governance posture** and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly.

In our selection process, we **prioritize intellect and judgement** alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment.

***Location:*** *This role will be based in our office in London, UK.*

### **The role entails**

* Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting it's structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas.
* Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly.
* Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team.
* Owning public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.
* Advising the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and supporting in Board and committee meetings.
* Owning the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.
* Leading intellectual property and open source licensing strategy, including copyleft, trademark and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.
* Owning the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation.
* Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality.
* Advising on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.

### **What we are looking for in you**

* An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
* A degree in law, or equivalent, and an active licence to practice in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.
* Substantial senior in-house experience in a global technology or software business.
* Proven experience leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones.
* A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out.
* Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.
* Technology related experience of:
  + negotiating and owning commercial technology contracts, including enterprise software and subscriptions, channel and reseller agreements, hardware manufacturer agreements, cloud and services
  + advising on open source licensing, including permissive and copyleft licences, and familiarity with how open source communities operate.
* Experience of, or demonstrable readiness for, public company governance: listing preparation, board and committee support, disclosure and controls.
* Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.
* Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and share ideas without hesitation.
* Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
* International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long.

### **Nice-to-have skills**

* Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practicing as counsel inside a listed company.
* A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.
* Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.
* Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. **Canonical is an equal opportunity employer**

title: Power System Engineer (Development Programme)
description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations and you'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in the office – Glasgow or Perth.

**Salary:** Starting Salary circa £46,000 + performance-related bonus + a range of other benefits to support your family, finances, and wellbeing.

**Working Pattern:** Permanent | Full Time | Flexible First options available

**The role**

SSEN Transmission has a unique opportunity to join a development programme to re-train to become a Power System Engineer. The candidates will join a fast-track 10-week specialist training module to learn how to undertake power system studies to support the integration of low carbon generation and related technologies onto the transmission system in the north of Scotland. Followed by three placement rotations across the planning and operational teams.

Our 24-month development programme, through work-based and academic training, is designed to support your understanding of technical requirements to develop into a Power System Engineer. Providing advanced simulation capability, from steady state power system analysis using PowerFactory through to cutting edge large scale Electro-Magnetic Transient (EMT) modelling using Power Systems Computer Aided Design (PSCAD) software on dedicated high-performance computing hardware.

**You will:**

* Under direction, develop skills to carry out system studies, technical assessments, planning and development of the Transmission network.

* Learn how to assess network performance, network capability, and identify options to maintain or enhance these.

* Support the System Performance and System Engineering & Investment teams, along with the Transmission Control Centre in making engineering recommendations for network improvements to meet the current and future requirements of SSEN Transmission; and gain confidence to make those recommendations as part of your role.

* Understand and develop skills to carry out a wide range of simulations and studies including power flow analysis, fault level studies, voltage and thermal capability, transient stability, fast switching studies, harmonic and power quality analysis to ensure licence and Grid Code obligations are met.

* Gain skills to ensure that the SSEN Transmission system is modelled accurately along with key interfaces and that the required data for detailed steady state and dynamic analysis of the transmission network is controlled.

You have:

* For this programme, you'll ideally have an MEng or minimum of a 2:2 BEng in an engineering, mathematics or science-based discipline.

* Strong mathematical and analytical skills, including problem solving, fault investigation, data analysis and interpretation of simulation results.

* An ability to manage and prioritise tasks ranging from technical problems to the portfolio of projects in the early stages of design/development.

* Enthusiasm to integrate with, and provide positive contribution to, a team of specialist engineering professionals; with the drive and potential to develop into a Power System Engineer

* Excellent communication, time-management, and organisational skills.

* Ideally have a basic understanding of power system fundamentals and network analysis, including generation, transmission, distribution, transformers, three-phase systems, load flow, fault level and power quality studies.

* Ideally have previous work experience in a professional setting, such as completed a graduate programme.

**About SSE**

SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all.

We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers.

Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030.

SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport electricity from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown power for the future and building the infrastructure needed for a cleaner electricity system to create secure power for generations to come.

**Flexible benefits to fit your life**

Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.

**Work with an equal opportunity employer**

SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. please contact Andy on andrew.torrance@sse.com / 01738 275370 to discuss how we can support you.

We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.

**Ready to apply?**

Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

title: Technology Specialist Graduate Programme
description:
**Technology Specialist Graduate Programme**

**Location:** Milton Keynes based, with occasional travel to nationwide sites

**Salary: £30,500 base salary**

**Additional Payments: £500 joining fee and a £3,000 Technology Annual Skills Premium** paid in monthly installments. The premium recognises the specialist skills developed through areas such as data analytics, supply chain management system configuration and deployment, and AI technology development.

**Duration:** 2-2.5 years

**Start date:** September 2027

**Who are DHL Supply Chain?**

We're the people behind some of the world's biggest brands, keeping products moving, businesses growing and customers happy. As part of DHL Group, the world's leading logistics company, we combine innovation, technology and brilliant people to deliver solutions that make a real impact. Join us and you'll discover opportunities to learn, grow and build a career without limits.

**What is the programme?**

IT is the nervous system of Supply Chain, we connect different parts of our organisation with each other and to customers, translating business needs into solutions across the globe. Graduates will gain broad experience across IT Operations, Technology Solutions, Project Delivery, Data & Analytics and Operational Technologies. Our programme is designed to develop well‑rounded IT professionals, with many progressing into leadership or specialist roles after completing the scheme.

While you'll specialise in Technology, you'll spend time understanding our operations firsthand, working closely with colleagues across warehouse, transport and customer environments to help deliver solutions that support the day-to-day running of the operation.

**What will I be doing?**

As part of the programme, you will gain:

* APM Project Management Qualification
* ITIL Foundation certification

Both are fully funded and supported by DHL as part of your structured development. You'll also receive ongoing mentoring, coaching, and exposure to senior IT leaders throughout your placements.

**Year 1: Foundations**

* Rotational placements across IT Operations, Solutions and Project teams.
* Gain exposure to warehouse and transport management systems and how they support DHL Supply Chain operations.
* Support the implementation, testing and rollout of technology solutions.
* Learn how technology projects are planned, delivered and supported within a live operational environment.
* Build stakeholder management skills by working with customers, suppliers and colleagues across the business.
* Gain experience in IT service management, training and documentation activities.

**Year 2: Development & Stretch**

* Take an active role in technology projects, business implementations and go-lives.
* Support digitalisation, automation and innovation initiatives across our operations.
* Gain exposure to project management, solution design and technology change management.
* Work with data and business intelligence teams to support reporting and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Lead smaller technology improvement projects and contribute to customer-focused solutions.
* Develop specialist product knowledge and build expertise in supporting operational technology systems.

**What skills do I need?**

We're not expecting you to have everything figured out from day one. We're looking for people with the potential to grow and develop throughout the programme.

* **Problem Solving:** You enjoy analysing challenges, thinking critically and finding practical solutions to improve systems and processes.
* **Digital Curiosity:** You're interested in technology and enjoy exploring new tools, platforms and emerging trends.
* **Analytical Thinking:** You can interpret information, spot patterns and use data to make informed decisions.
* **Continuous Improvement:** You're naturally curious and always looking for ways to make processes more efficient, effective and user-friendly.
* **Communication:** You're comfortable explaining technical concepts in a clear and straightforward way to different audiences.
* **Relationship Building:** You enjoy working collaboratively and can build positive relationships with colleagues, customers and stakeholders.
* **Adaptability:** You're open to learning new technologies, embracing change and working in a fast-paced environment.
* **Initiative:** You take ownership of your development, seek out opportunities to learn and are motivated to make a positive impact.

**What are the entry requirements?**

* Achieved, or be on track to achieve, a 2:1 degree or above.
* Willing and able to relocate within commuting distance of your placement.
* Hold a full UK driving licence or be able to travel independently to multiple sites when required.
* Have a genuine interest in supply chain, logistics, technology and IT operations.
* Candidates must have the unrestricted right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme.

**We're particularly interested in graduates from disciplines such as:**

* Computer Science
* Information Technology (IT)
* Software Engineering
* Cyber Security
* Data Science
* Computer Systems Engineering
* Digital Technology Solutions
* Business Information Systems
* Information Systems Management
* Network Engineering
* Artificial Intelligence

**Don't see your degree listed? We'd still love to hear from candidates with a genuine interest in Supply Chain and Logistics.**

**What's in it for me?**

* 25 days' holiday, plus bank holidays
* Bonus eligible (April each year)
* Eligible for £500 joining payment to help support relocation and settling into your new location, plus eligibility for a further relocation allowance of up to £500 in your second year, subject to terms and conditions
* Eligible for a pay increase 6 months after joining, through our annual salary review process, paid in April each year
* Eligible for our Holiday Purchase scheme
* Generous pension scheme with an 8% employer contribution and 4% employee contribution
* Free 24/7 confidential GP service
* Hundreds of retail, leisure and lifestyle discounts
* Financial wellbeing support, including savings schemes, affordable loans and free mortgage advice
* Mental health and wellbeing support
* The opportunity to join employee networks: Ability, Ethnic and National origin, Religion, Gender, LGBTQ+, and Generations
* Exposure to senior leaders and a strong network of graduates and early career professionals
* Structured development opportunities, including internal development programmes

**What is the application process?**

**1. Online Application & Assessment** - Complete a short application form, upload your CV, and complete a situational judgement assessment (approximately 1 hour).

**2. Video Interview** - Record your responses to a series of interview questions, with up to three attempts per question.

**3. Assessment Centre** - Attend an in-person assessment centre to showcase your skills and potential.

title: Actuarial Consulting & Analytics: Summer Internship Programme
description:
At Hymans Robertson, actuarial consulting is at the heart of what we do - combining our analytical expertise with a deep understanding of pensions, benefits and financial risk to deliver tailored solutions for our clients. Whether advising on Defined Benefit schemes or supporting Local Government Pension Schemes (LGPS), our actuaries play a pivotal role in helping people to make informed decisions.  
  
We are excited to welcome applications for our Actuarial Consulting & Analytics internship programme, which is a perfect next step for those looking to launch their careers within this field!  
  
**What does our internship programme look like?**  
Taking place for eight weeks over July and August, our internship programme will give you the chance to gain experience, build your confidence and grow your professional network.  
  
Depending on your skills and interests, you will be aligned to either one of our Actuarial Consulting Business Units (Actuarial Private or Actuarial Public) or to our Technical (Insights & Analytics) team. Whichever direction you follow, you will be supported by experienced and friendly colleagues to explore what a graduate role would be like within your area.  
  
Though these career pathways are complimentary, they offer distinct opportunities to specialise and build your knowledge. In all cases you’ll collaborate with experienced consultants and analysts to contribute to meaningful client projects as you learn the core principles that drive our industry forward.

Some of the key activities you will be involved in will include:

* Working with our consultants on providing analysis of large data sets and helping present the results of this in easily understandable formats, to formulate advice for their clients
* Gaining an understanding of how to work with data modelling tools and software
* Working on an individual project aligned to your business unit and presenting your findings from this to colleagues towards the end of your internship.

One of the best features of our internship programme is that those who do well throughout it can be offered a ring-fenced space on our graduate programme for the following year. So this is a great opportunity for you not just to gain a better understanding of graduate careers in this field with us, but also for you to secure a graduate job for once you have completed your degree!  
  
**If you enjoy the following, we think you’ll love this opportunity:**

* Building relationships and communicating with people
* Working with large sets of detailed data and other forms of information
* Solving complex problems
* A fun and fast-paced working environment, where you are encouraged to collaborate with your colleagues
* Being adaptable and flexible in your approach to tasks

Our internship programme is only open to penultimate year university students. But you don’t need to be joining us from a purely maths, economics or actuarial science based subject to excel in this role as we recognise that any University degree will give you an amazing set of transferable skills that are valuable in any workplace. However, we do require you to have the ability to work well with numbers.  
  
**In addition to a competitive salary we offer:**

* A flexible selection of employee benefits, so you can choose a package that best matches your lifestyle and needs
* A collaborative and supportive work environment where your thinking and ideas are encouraged
* On site mental health and wellbeing support
* A commitment to helping you develop both personally and professionally, with mentoring opportunities and access to our award-winning learning portal, Aspire
* Regular social activities

Earlier this year were proud to be rated eighth in the HigherIn Award category for Best Student Employers! Take a **look through some of our reviews** to find out more about what our previous students enjoyed about their time with us!  
  
You can find out more about why we think Hymans is a great place to work and the business units aligned to this programme by **visiting our Early Careers site**!  
  
We have opportunities across each of our four UK based offices – in Edinburgh, Glasgow, London and Birmingham. And we offer hybrid working so you can enjoy the positive wellbeing of working from home as well as the benefits of meeting colleagues in our sociable, modern office environments.  
  
Please note, we recruit on a rolling basis, so early applications are encouraged to avoid disappointment.  
  
We are committed to being open and transparent in our recruitment and reward processes. Please note that this vacancy does not currently meet the minimum salary threshold requirements for Skilled Worker sponsorship within the UK.  
  
To avoid any disappointment, if you require sponsorship we would encourage you to check whether you may be eligible for a discounted salary threshold, or to explore alternative routes to secure your right to work in the UK before submitting your application. If you meet the criteria outlined in the job description we’ll be happy to discuss your individual circumstances further with you.

We work alongside employers, trustees and financial services institutions, offering independent pensions, investments, benefits and risk consulting services, as well as data and technology solutions.

That's the who and the what. More important is the 'why'. The work we do may not always seem the sexiest. But it's difficult, it's complex, and it's important. We help our clients, their employees, members and customers make decisions that have real and direct consequences on their financial futures.

For 100 years we've taken this responsibility seriously. Together, as a team and with our clients and partners, we're here to build better futures.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer

* Support client engagement and maintain positive working relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and repeat business.

* Build and maintain relationships with Clients, Architects, Engineers, and Contractors

  

* Provide input to fee proposals and bid submissions where required. Support preparation of project bids

  

* Represent the company at industry events and conferences where required

* Oversee project delivery ensuring quality, time, and budget requirements are met

  

* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including Architects, C&S Engineers, Sustainability Consultants etc

  

* Manage client relationships and communications throughout project lifecycles

  

* Ensure projects meet quality assurance standards and client expectations

  

* Support client communication throughout project lifecycles.

**What** **we’re** **looking** **for:**

  

* Honours / master’s degree in engineering, Architecture, or related field or demonstratable equivalent professional experience.
* Chartered status (CEng, MCIBSE, or equivalent) is highly desirable
* Extensive experience in Engineer Consultancy (or similar role), including leading complex projects and client relationships
* Experience mentoring engineers and supporting staff development.
* Strong knowledge of building regulations, energy standards, and certification schemes
* Understanding of renewable energy systems and low-carbon technologies
* Knowledge of sustainable MEP systems including heat pumps, geothermal, solar PV, and energy storage
* Understanding of building automation, smart building technologies, and IoT integration
* Knowledge of public and private sector procurement processes
* Understanding of engineering design and project delivery processes
* Excellent presentation and communication skills
* Strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities
* Proven track record in developing and maintaining effective working relationships at all levels.
* Proficiency in technical software
* Understanding of building automation, smart building technologies, and IoT integration
* Knowledge of whole life and embodied carbon analysis
* Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary environments
* experience managing business unit P&L
Strong project management and client relationship skills

**What'****s** **in** **it for you?**

* Competitive salary

**RYBKA**, part of the BRUSH Group, is a multi-disciplined engineering consultancy practice that specialise in mechanical, electrical and public health (MEP) projects in the built environment. title: Learning and Development Manager (Technology)
description:
**Are you passionate about building technical capability at scale and helping engineering teams thrive in a rapidly evolving AI landscape?**

  

**Do you enjoy partnering with leaders, subject matter experts, and early career talent to create learning experiences that drive measurable impact?**

  

**About our Team**

The Elsevier Technology Learning & Development team plays a critical role in building the skills that power our global technology organisation. We partner with engineering leaders, technical experts and business stakeholders to ensure our people have the capabilities needed to succeed in a rapidly evolving landscape shaped by AI, data and modern software engineering. Our team values trust, respect, collaboration, agility, and quality.

  
  

**About the Role**

As Learning and Development Manager, you will independently lead technical capability programmes across AI-native engineering, Data Science and Data Engineering, Software Engineering and early careers. Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Learning & Development, you will partner with leaders, engineering SMEs and learning champions to take programmes from curriculum design through global delivery and evidenced certification. You will also manage the learning platforms and learner-led ecosystem that enable capability development at scale across Technology teams in North America, India and Europe.

This role will play a key part in building future-ready technical talent by creating impactful learning experiences, driving AI fluency, and ensuring capability growth is evidenced through practical application and measurable outcomes.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Lead technical capability programmes end-to-end across AI Engineering, Data Science and Early Careers, from design through delivery, assessment and rollout.
* Partner with Technology leaders and SMEs to identify capability needs and translate them into effective learning solutions.
* Drive adoption of the AI Fluency Framework by designing learning pathways and development experiences that build capability across engineering teams.
* Own assessment and certification approaches, ensuring capability is evidenced through practical application rather than completion alone.
* Partner with the Senior L&D Manager to shape the graduate capability strategy, including demand planning and delivery of technical bootcamps.
* Manage learning platforms and resources, ensuring a high-quality learner experience.
* Oversee external learning partners, maintaining delivery quality, scope and standards.
* Establish measurement frameworks and reporting to evaluate capability growth, engagement, adoption and programme effectiveness.
  

  

**Requirements**

* Proven experience designing and delivering engaging technical learning programmes within a global technology environment, supported by content creation skills across digital, written and blended formats.
* Able to diagnose capability gaps and distinguish learning needs from process, tooling or management challenges.
* Credibility with technical audiences, supported by a working understanding of software engineering, data, GenAI technologies and the application of AI tools within engineering environments.
* Experience developing graduate or early-career talent programmes that accelerate readiness and productivity.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior leaders, SMEs and business partners.
* Skilled facilitator who can adapt delivery to audience needs and evaluate learning adoption, behaviour change and capability growth through data and insights.
* Experience managing external learning providers and ensuring high-quality programme delivery.
* Experience with Workday Learning or similar LMS/LXP platforms.
* Understanding of apprenticeship levy funding and other external learning routes.
* Formal L&D, instructional design or learning professional qualification.

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

  
  

**Working Pattern**

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals’ advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

description:

And we’re prioritising diversity, equity and inclusion in our workplace and communities, while reducing our impact on the environment. We are using technology as a force for good; for our people, our partners and the planet.

Cybersecurity Services Delivery Management

The roles will be varied, some strategic, others more operational, giving you a flavour of different career paths. You may also have the option in your second year for an international rotation within our Operating Companies and Ventures. **LEARNING AND DEVELOPMENT**

At Liberty Global we are committed to developing talented people to move onwards and upwards through our organization during their programme and beyond.

Additionally, from a cybersecurity perspective working for an organisation that provides broadband, video and mobile communications is an excellent learning opportunity.”*

Lani Allan – Cybersecurity Graduate

* 25 days’ holiday each year

* Ride to work and bicycle purchase schemes
* Medical, health, dental, travel and disability insurance

**WHAT WE LOOK FOR**

We’re looking for graduates with an analytical approach, who are high-reaching and keen to pursue a career in cybersecurity. We want to see your passion for technology, your confidence in pushing the boundaries and your creative approach. We seek individuals with an aptitude for technical learning across qualifications such as Computer Science; Cybersecurity; AI; and Information Security;, but equally, we would like to see in you qualities that include: Exposure to AI, coding or software development is also desirable, whether gained through your degree, an AI/ML minor or module, academic work, or personal projects. In particular, experience with Python or another programming language, automation/scripting, software engineering fundamentals, data analysis or AI/ML concepts would be valuable, alongside an interest in the security implications of AI-enabled technologies.

  

* Curiosity
* Resilience
* Collaboration
* Solution led approach.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion vision is at the core of our purpose. We believe in creating a culture that empowers our colleagues to achieve their potential and bring their whole selves to work every day. We are committed to taking on discrimination in all its forms and being a positive force for good in the world today.

Connect with us today.

title: Construction Associate
description:
What we will offer:

If you require this document in an accessible format (e.g. large print), please contact hr.recruitment@shlegal.com

We will offer you a place where you can be yourself and where there are no limits on what you can achieve. With us, you can take ownership of your career and have honest conversations throughout. You would join an ambitious firm with a clear strategy for profitable growth where you can get early responsibility. Here you can expect a competitive and fair reward as well as recognition based on all round performance. This forms part of our internal promise to you, The Deal, between the firm and its employees.

Team Structure:

At Stephenson Harwood, our projects and construction teams are combined, with some of our fee earners (particularly those towards the NQ-junior end) developing experience across projects, energy, infrastructure and real estate construction work. In addition to acting in the UK domestic market, the team has an international offering and frequently works alongside colleagues in the Middle East and Asia as well as our other European offices, on developments in those jurisdictions.

We are currently seeking a mid-level with non-contentious real estate construction experience. Projects experience is also desirable (albeit not required) but is not a substitute for real estate construction experience, which is essential for this role. Please note the role does not include any contentious construction work (which is dealt with by a separate department).

We are recruiting for this role to replace a mid-level associate who is relocating overseas. The role will involve a busy and varied workload of UK domestic real estate construction matters, comprising a mix of pure development work, advisory work, and real estate and finance transactional support. This represents a very good opportunity for a keen mid-level lawyer keen to embrace a busy workload from the outset.
  
You can expect to advise on a broad range of commercial real estate developments in several sectors including mixed-use commercial, industrial, hotel & leisure and retail, PBSA, BTR, and high end residential.

The team acts for a diverse client base comprising institutional investors, project sponsors, private developers, owner/occupiers, government bodies and public authorities, funders, contractors, consultants, and other stakeholders involved in high value construction and engineering work.

You will work closely with one partner initially, and four other partners in addition.

Main Responsibilities:

Your main responsibilities would include:

* leading matter management on smaller/less complex matters with minimal supervision of a partner;
* working alongside partners and managing associates on more complex matters;
* clear, concise and unambiguous preparation and drafting of relevant documentation;
* conducting legal research using internal and external knowledge management resources;
* liaising with clients under the supervision of a partner or managing associate;
* assisting partners with matter management and financial hygiene of matters;
* supervising more junior associates and trainees/solicitor apprentices;
* developing own internal and external network of contacts;
* building excellent working relationships with clients and peers within the firm;
* attending business development and profile-raising events (client seminars, industry and trade body networking, graduate recruitment activities).

The intention is that this role will be predominantly office based, in line with the firm's policy of working 3 days per week in the office. We are happy to discuss this and other flexible working arrangements with you as part of the application and interview process.

Attributes/Skills Required:

* UK-qualified lawyer with demonstrable mid-level experience gained with a strong private practice law firm in the UK is likely to be the best fit for the current needs of the team. However, foreign qualified candidates with equivalent and/or comparable experience in similar markets (for example, Ireland, Australia and New Zealand) market will be considered. The candidate will have a strong academic record.
* The candidate should be a proactive and collaborative self-starter.
* Strong technical knowledge and excellent attention to detail is essential.
* The candidate will have experience with:

* general commercial real estate development, including a working knowledge of the JCT suite of contracts. Experience of NEC (in particular) and also FIDIC, MF/1, and IChemE forms of contract is also highly desirable.
* drafting and negotiating bespoke consultancy appointments (essential).
* drafting and negotiating other bespoke contractual arrangements, such as construction management agreements and DMAs is highly desirable.
* the non-contentious construction elements of real estate and funding documents such as agreements for lease, sale and purchase agreements, development funding and forward funding agreements, development finance and the refinancing of real estate assets.

* Experience and expertise at independently managing non-complex transactional construction files with little supervision.
* Delivering commercial pragmatic advice to clients and colleagues which places the construction risks in the context of the wider transaction.
* A strong interest in legal technology and AI, with a keenness to embrace the use of software such as Harvey and Legora.
* Ability to acquire, consolidate and apply fundamental and up-to-date knowledge of the law. The team does not currently include a PSL, so fee earners are expected to take responsibility for keeping up-to-date with legal and commercial developments.
* Organised and able to work to strict deadlines with the ability to prioritise realistically including flagging any conflicting urgent deadlines to partners in a contemporaneous fashion.
* Good housekeeping/file management practices.
* Manages and records time daily and accurately with an awareness of fee quotes/estimates.
* Resilient with the ability to handle setbacks and pressure.
* Exhibits an understanding of the firm’s position in the market and how it distinguishes its services from its competitors.

  
About the Firm:

Stephenson Harwood is an international law firm, and we're committed to creating 'positive partnerships' with our clients. We represent listed and private companies, institutions and individuals, building lasting relationships to help them succeed in a complex and ever-changing world.

Our focus is on five core sectors: Energy Transition, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Private Capital and Funds, Technology, and Transportation and Trade.

With more than 1,500 people, including 250+ partners, across eleven offices in Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we combine deep legal capabilities and broad commercial expertise. We have also forged close ties with high quality law firms around the world, blending local knowledge with global savvy for clients in over 100 countries.

We understand the power of diversity in delivering that high calibre advice to our clients. We want to attract diverse talent and we particularly encourage applications from underrepresented demographics.

* 11 OFFICES
* 45+ LANGUAGES SPOKEN BY OUR PEOPLE

*Offices in Al Khobar, Athens, Dubai, Hong Kong, London, Madrid, Paris, Riyadh, Seoul, Shanghai, Singapore and associated office in Guangzhou*

Our brand strengths:

**GO FAR, GO TOGETHER**

**EXPERTS IN MORE THAN LAW**

**CAN DO PERSONALITIES**

**ALWAYS READY**

**Technology Apprentice (Platform Engineering)**

We are seeking a highly motivated, curious, and resilient Technology Apprentice to join our Platform Engineering teams. This is a fantastic opportunity to kick-start a dynamic career in platform or cloud engineering by blending formal education with hands-on, practical coding experience.

Depending on your current qualifications, this role will involve the completion of a**Level 4 Software Developer Apprenticeship** (with potential to progress to a degree) or direct entry into a **BSc (Hons) Applied Software Engineering Integrated Degree Apprenticeship (Level 6).**

**The Role: Technology Apprentice (Platform Engineering)**

The Technology Apprentice will leverage a strong passion for learning and technology, and will contribute directly to our platform development lifecycle. You will successfully balance formal apprenticeship studies with hands-on infrastructure as code, testing, and platform design tasks. Working closely with experienced engineers and technical mentors, you will help build, secure, and support platforms to host software applications that drive our business forward.

***This role follows a hybrid working model that requires 2–3 days per week on-site at our Northampton office. Additionally, travel to training locations and other TP Group sites may be necessary, so you must hold a full UK drivers licence and occasional work outside of standard hours may be required.***

**Your Learning Journey & Accountabilities:**

  

* **Continuous Learning & Apprenticeship:** Dedicate the required off-the-job training time to your formal apprenticeship studies. Successfully blend academic learning with practical coding application, taking ownership of your professional development and applying newly learned skills, tools, and engineering techniques to your day-to-day work.
  
* **Platform Development & Delivery:** Work to agile principles to write, test, and deploy clean, maintainable Infrastructure As Code. Actively participate in team ceremonies (such as daily stand-ups and sprint planning) and collaborate with the team to deliver high-quality platform capabilities.
* **Debugging & Problem Solving:** Investigate software bugs and technical challenges logically. Work alongside senior engineers to debug code, identify root causes, consider alternative approaches, and implement effective, simple solutions.
  
* **Secure Coding & DevSecOps Practices:** Adopt an engineering mindset that prioritises security and reliability. Learn to apply secure coding practices, gain exposure to automated delivery pipelines (CI/CD), and assist with the support and incident management of live platforms services.
* **Customer Focus & Teamwork:** Develop a strong customer-centric mindset, ensuring that the platform capabilities you build and support prioritise the needs and experiences of our internal customers. Work effectively both independently and as part of a diverse development squad.
  
* **Code & Technical Documentation:** Assist in creating and maintaining clear technical documentation for codebases and platform configurations to ensure they are easily understood and supported by the engineering and support teams.
* **Adaptability & Resilience:**Adapt to a fast-moving landscape, keeping pace with the latest cloud and software trends to comfortably transition between different technical challenges, whether modernising legacy systems or building new features.
  

**What You’ll Bring:**

  

* A Levels, or equivalent Level 3 qualification/industry experience
  
* A demonstrated practical interest in Public Cloud and platform development (e.g., through school computer science projects, building personal websites, basic coding/scripting hobbies, or self-directed tech learning) and an eagerness to continuously improve.
  
* Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and experience working collaboratively as part of a team.
  

**Commitment to Inclusion:**We are dedicated to fostering a truly inclusive employment environment where all colleagues feel safe, respected, and empowered to be their authentic selves. If you meet the essential qualifications and have a genuine passion for technology, we strongly encourage you to apply—we value diverse perspectives and potential just as much as prior professional experience.

**Professional Growth:** You’ll be supported by some fantastic training and development and have the opportunity to learn, grow and develop across the Travis Perkins Group.

Additionally, we provide a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, designed to grow with your tenure:

  

* Competitive base salary plus an annual bonus linked to business performance
  
* Generous pension scheme with matched contributions (based on length of service)
  
* Save as you earn and share schemes that let you share in the Group's success.
  
* Colleague discount across Travis Perkins Group brands.
  

  

**About Travis Perkins**

Travis Perkins is the UK’s largest distributor of building materials, with a legacy spanning over 200 years of contributing to national infrastructure. The Group operates over 5 businesses, employing 16,000 colleagues across more than 1,200 branches, stores, and sites throughout the UK. We are committed to fostering a challenging and rewarding work environment where dedicated professionals collaborate to deliver outstanding results.

title: Apprentice Full Stack Developer
description:
Maritime Transport is looking for a motivated **Apprentice Full Stack Developer** to join our development team at our **Felixstowe Head Office**. This is an exciting opportunity to learn, grow and contribute to the build, enhancement and deployment of business-critical software used across the organization. This role will be supplemented with an Apprenticeship in Software Development.

You will work with modern web-based applications built using C#, .NET and Angular, gaining hands-on experience in coding, testing, reviewing, maintaining and researching solutions within an agile, team-based environment.

Maritime Transport is a strong, growing business with a secure future and a reputation for recognising and rewarding hard work. Based in a modern office environment, our development function plays an important role in supporting key operational systems across the business.

We operate and are legally responsible for more than 4,500 assets across over 40 UK locations, including heavy goods vehicles, trailers, company cars and plant machinery. Our core platforms support the management, maintenance and compliance of these assets throughout their operational and financial lifecycle.

This role would suit someone who is organised, eager to learn, comfortable solving problems and able to think quickly in a fast-paced business environment.

  

* Competitive salary
* Full training given
* Opportunities to progress
* Annual salary review (discretionary)
* Annual bonus (discretionary)
* 25 days holiday plus 8 bank holidays on top from day 1
* Life assurance cover x3 from day 1 and up to age 66
* Group personal pension
* Employee assistance programme
* Big discounts on MSC cruises for yourself, family and friends
* You’ll be working for one of the market leaders

As part of your apprenticeship, you will develop the skills and experience needed to help deliver reliable, secure and well-documented software solutions. Your responsibilities will include:

* Initial focus will be to learn and provide support to stakeholders, helping triage and resolve issues pre and post release for our internally developed software
* Work with Business Analysts, Project Managers and stakeholders to understand requirements and help deliver effective technical solutions.
* Support the maintenance of build and release pipelines.
* Collaborate with a small team of developers in an agile environment.
* Contribute to planning, estimating and reviewing upcoming development work.
* Produce clean, testable, secure and performance-focused code.
* Carry out testing to help ensure high-quality software delivery.
* Deliver documented, deployable solutions for internal customers.
* Continue developing your technical knowledge through self-learning and hands-on experience.

  

* Clear and confident communication with technical and non-technical colleagues.
* Understanding of SOLID principles and object-oriented programming.
* Experience working in agile delivery environments, including Scrum or Kanban.
* Ability to work from clearly defined specifications.
* Confidence to question and challenge designs constructively based on technical merits.
* Understanding of microservices and interoperability between services.
* Awareness of behavior-driven, domain-driven and test-driven development approaches.

  

* C# and .NET, including .NET Core
* Git source control.
* Entity Framework and SQL Server.
* JavaScript, TypeScript and Angular.
* Dependency injection, including Autofac.
* REST APIs built to OpenAPI specifications, as both provider and consumer.
* Thread-safety and immutability by design.
* NuGet library packaging
* Cursor

  

* Azure DevOps experience.
* WebSockets over HTTP/2 or SignalR.
* Cloud development, deployment or management experience, including Docker or similar technologies.
* RabbitMQ or similar messaging technologies.
* AutoMapper or similar mapping tools.
* Sieve or similar filtering/query tools.
* Framework development experience.
* Bootstrap, Kendo UI or Angular experience.

  

* Full UK driving license.
* Aptitude for computing technology and aware of the latest technological developments.
* Ability to describe technical information in easy-to-understand terms.

  

* A strong team player who enjoys working collaboratively.
* Organized, reliable and able to manage tasks effectively.
* Adaptable and comfortable learning new technologies.
* Creative, curious and willing to solve problems.

You will work towards a recognized Software development qualification, such as a ***Level 4 Software Development*** apprenticeship ***or suitable equivalent***. Dedicated study time will be provided, alongside ongoing mentoring and development support from experienced Developers.

The successful candidate will enjoy a competitive salary and remuneration package and excellent benefits.

Should you not hear back from us then your application will have been unsuccessful on this occasion.

Maritime is a family-owned UK-based transport company and since its inception in 2001 has grown to be a market-leader offering container transport and curtain-sided distribution services. With a network of over 40 depots spanning the UK Maritime offers transport and logistics solutions to a large and growing customer base, and works with a high number of large blue chip businesses. Join a winning team.

title: 2027 Technology Developer Degree Apprenticeship Programme Northampton
description:
Date live: 09/09/2026

Business Area: See job description

Area of Expertise: Early Careers

Contract: Apprentice

Reference Code: JR-0000129431

  

**Annual Salary £25,200 + benefits**

Getting qualified. It's a huge achievement that can completely change your prospects – but it’s not always open to everyone, whether that's due to the cost of university or the timing not being right. But with our apprenticeships, all that can change. Here at Barclays we offer a world-class programme that provides you with a permanent, full-time job with a competitive salary from day one - all whilst gaining a professional qualification at the same time. Whether you're a school-leaver looking for alternative options to the traditional university route or you're someone thinking differently about your future, we'll help you to build an extraordinary career at Barclays, no matter your background.

  
  

Our programme is designed for school leavers and career changers, but is open to anyone, no matter your background or your age. If you already have a degree, make sure you visit https://search.jobs.barclays/graduates and consider our graduate opportunities.

  
  

**Why a Barclays Apprenticeship?**

You’ll get the opportunity to earn whilst working towards a Digital & Technology Solutions Professional Degree Apprenticeship, a perfect blend of theoretical learning and real-life practical work whilst on a full-time salary in a permanent job. A unique chance to get a professional qualification without the student loan, all whilst getting years of work experience under your belt. Due to the evolving nature of Apprenticeships, a new Apprenticeship might become available and if deemed more relevant to your role, we'll change the Apprenticeship before you start.

  
  

We’ve spent over a decade perfecting the support that you’ll receive on our Apprenticeship programme. From day one, you’ll be assigned a Programme Support Manager matched to your needs and background, and together with your People Leader, they’ll support you as an individual. We’ll also match you to an expert in your specialist subject, ready to share their knowledge.

  
  

The Apprenticeship route gives you the opportunity for self-discovery and helps you to explore different career paths. With over 325 years of expertise in Banking, Barclays operates in 39 countries, employing around 90,000 people to help move, lend, invest and protect money for customers and clients worldwide.

  
  

**Why the Technology Developer Apprenticeship programme?**

Technology Developers build and improve the systems that support Barclays. You’ll learn software engineering practices, collaborate with experienced teams and help create reliable, secure digital services.

  
  

**Are you eligible?**

First, you’ll need the right qualifications. For this apprenticeship opportunity you’ll need 3 A-levels at BBB (or equivalent), plus GCSE Mathematics and English Language (grade A\*-C / 9-4) or equivalent.

  
  

Beyond that though, we’re also looking for commitment and enthusiasm. Our Apprenticeships place deep investment in you as an individual. That means we need you to match that commitment: you’ll turn up every day ready to work hard, push yourself, and think differently about what you’re capable of.

  
  

To apply for our apprentice programme, you must meet the Government's apprentice funding requirements that apply to you (as outlined in https://www.gov.uk/ for apprentices in England and in https://www.saas.gov.uk/ for apprentices in Scotland).

  
  

The Government apprentice funding requirements include a number of requirements that you must meet, including a 3 year residence requirement (subject to certain exceptions). To qualify for the Government's apprentice funding requirements, you must also have the legal right to work for the full duration of the programme at the point of enrolment, with no gaps in your legal right to work or dependency on future visa applications during the period of your apprenticeship (August 2027 to August 2031).

  
  

You must also not have undertaken any previous study, education, training, qualifications, or apprenticeship, gained learning or competence from prior work experience, or received prior funding or financial support which renders you ineligible for the Government’s apprentice funding.

  
  

**Working In Northampton**

Our environmentally friendly campus is designed with people in mind. With cafés, collaboration spaces, green spaces, wellbeing areas, parking, public transport links and a shuttle bus service, it’s a place where work feels good.

  
  

**What happens once you apply?**

Step 1 - We'll review your application
  
Step 2 - You'll be asked to complete our online assessments
  
Step 3 - We'll ask you to complete a survey, so we can be sure of your eligibility
  
Step 4 - It's time to attend an in-person assessment day, where you'll be assessed during a group activity and interview (this will take place from October 2026)
  
Step 5 - We'll let you know the outcome and give you feedback.

  
  

It is the policy of Barclays to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.

  
  

The closing date for applications is 31 October 2026. Please note that this vacancy may close ahead of the advertised date due to application volumes, and we therefore recommend submitting your application as early as possible.

**Purpose of the role**

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participation in code reviews, and promotion of a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To meet the needs of stakeholders/ customers through operational excellence and customer service
* Perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard
* No people leadership roles at this grade.
* Execute work requirements as identified in processes and procedures, collaborating with and impacting on the work of team members.
* Identify escalation of policy breaches as required.
* Take responsibility for customer service and operational execution tasks.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Gain and maintain an understanding of own role, how the team integrates to achieve overall objectives, alongside knowledge of the work of other teams within the function.
* Work within well-defined procedures that may involve a variety of work routines.
* Demonstrate an understanding of the procedures.
* Evaluate and select the appropriate alternatives from defined options.
* Make judgements based on the analysis of factual information.
* Build relationships with stakeholders and customers to identify and address their needs, in support of a smooth operating process, handling sensitive issues as required.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
