title: Junior Backend Developer
description:
**About AX-ai**

AX-ai is a technology and AI consultancy. We help organisations modernise legacy systems, build digital platforms that scale, and use AI in practical ways that make commercial sense.

We don't do hype or experiments for their own sake. We build real software that solves real business problems, and it runs in production every day.

**The role**

We are looking for a Junior Backend Engineer to help maintain and improve the production systems we run for our clients. These are live web platforms that handle thousands of users and their personal data, with integrations to CRMs, messaging providers, ad platforms and partner APIs.

This is not a traditional junior role inside a large team. You will work directly with the Head of Engineering and closely with our Senior Management Team. From your first weeks you will fix real bugs in real systems. We will support you, review your work and give you more responsibility as you grow.

Most of your time will go on backend logic, APIs, data and debugging. You will also work on admin tools and user-facing forms, but this is not mainly a UI role.

**What you'll do**

* Fix bugs and edge cases across APIs, forms and integrations
* Make backend changes: validation, API responses, data handling and background jobs
* Troubleshoot third-party integrations (CRM, SMS and email, ad-platform tracking, partner APIs)
* Improve admin tools, reports and dashboards our clients use every day
* Investigate issues using logs and error tracking (Sentry, PostHog) across the frontend, backend and database
* Write and update tests for backend logic
* Use AI coding tools every day, and review what they produce as critically as you would your own code

**Our stack**

* TypeScript, Node.js and Next.js (React)
* Prisma with MySQL
* Redis and background job queues
* AWS (Docker on ECS)
* GitHub, with CI on every pull request
* Claude Code and Codex

**What we're looking for**

* Experience building or changing backend code in Node.js (APIs, validation, data handling)
* A working understanding of databases and APIs from real project work
* Ability to debug a problem that spans the frontend, backend and database
* Projects you've built or contributed to beyond tutorials
* Confidence with Git and pull-request workflows
* Comfort working in an existing codebase that keeps changing
* Experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, and an example of catching a mistake they made
* Eagerness to learn fast and take feedback well

**Nice to have**

* TypeScript, React or Next.js
* SQL, or an ORM such as Prisma
* Experience with third-party APIs, webhooks or queues
* Familiarity with dates and time zones (you'll meet a lot of UK summer-time bugs)
* Exposure to analytics or tracking tools (Google Tag Manager, Meta Conversions API, PostHog/Sentry)

**What we offer**

* Direct access to senior leadership and real decisions from day one
* Hands-on experience with production software used by thousands of people
* Mentoring and code review from the Head of Engineering
* Flexible, hybrid working
* A clear path to progress as our technical team grows
* Free on-site parking

Pay: £30,000.00-£35,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Free parking
* On-site parking

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Gateshead NE11 9SY: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

Work Location: In person

title: IT Delivery - Lead Software Engineer - IT1
description:
Every year, families across the UK choose Parkdean Resorts for their holidays, and almost every part of that experience, from the moment they start thinking about a break to the moment they check out, depends on our software working properly. The Lead Software Engineer role is where the quality of that software gets set.
  
This is a senior, hands-on engineering role where you’ll lead from the front.
  
You’ll take ownership of the technical direction within a product squad, while remaining actively involved in writing and reviewing production code. Alongside this, you’ll line manage and develop a team of Junior and Mid-Level Developers - helping them grow through hands-on coaching, feedback, and mentorship.
  
Working across our modern product stack (C#, ASP.NET, React, Azure, and SQL Server), you’ll be responsible for building and evolving the applications that support both our customers and our colleagues across 65 holiday parks.
  
This is true product engineering - focused on the applications and experiences that matter most, working in close collaboration with our Cloud & Platform teams who support infrastructure and tooling.
  
What you will be doing...
  

* Setting the engineering standard through the code you write and review
* Owning technical design for features and components within your squad
* Leading, coaching and developing engineers through pairing, feedback, and regular 1:1s
* Building high-quality, production-ready software with testing embedded throughout
* Ensuring strong engineering practices across CI/CD, automation, and observability
* Driving performance, scalability, and security across the development lifecycle
* Collaborating closely with Product, Delivery, and Architecture teams to shape feasible, effective solutions
* Contributing to out-of-hours support, taking ownership of issues within your domain

About you...
  

* C# and ASP.NET with strong, hands-on production experience
* React (or similar modern front-end framework)
* Azure application services in a production environment
* SQL Server, including performance tuning and diagnostics
* REST APIs and third-party integrations (e.g. Salesforce)
* Modern engineering practices including testing, CI/CD, and automation
* Writes and reviews production code regularly
* Brings strong technical judgement and a high bar for quality
* Has experience mentoring or leading developers in a team environment
* Takes pride in developing others, as well as delivering great software

we're looking for someone who’s truly hands-on - actively writing production code day to day, not just drawing on past experience. You’ll have a strong track record of mentoring or leading engineers, paired with excellent technical judgement, high standards for code quality, and the ability to raise the bar across a team.
  
Previous line management experience is essential. If you’ve already managed direct reports, you’ll be able to make an immediate impact.
  
So, why Parkdean Resorts?
  
Well, besides the one-of-a-kind team culture, stunning locations across the UK, and the chance to work with the UK's largest holiday park organisation, we can offer:
  

* The chance to develop your skills and boost your career across our 65 parks – we’ve got your back when it comes to training!
* You’re never on your own with our Employee Assistance Programme! It comes with a 24/7 confidential helpline for counselling and support - because your wellbeing is our top priority.
* A 50% discount for you and a 25% discount for friends and family when booking your holiday with us.
* A team member discount of 30%, available on everything from fabulous food to delicious drinks and even our fun leisure activities.
* Score awesome discounts! From tasty meal kits like Hello Fresh to your favourite local gyms, we’ve got deals on lots of brands just for you.

We want to be a force for good and caring for our parks, people, and planet is a natural component of the way we do business. We celebrate our people, communities and natural environment, enabling us to enhance the amazing memories we create for many years to come.
  
Are we the right fit for you?
  
At Parkdean Resorts, every park is a place to start something great; a place where you can develop your skills, take on new challenges, and thrive alongside a team that supports you every step of the way.
  
Our parks create meaningful memories for our guests and know that great service is more than a smile - it’s understanding the value of every moment. Because it’s not just what we do, it’s who we are. Join a team that puts heart into every holiday. Be the Heart of the Park.
  
Parkdean Resorts takes safeguarding seriously therefore background checks including DBS (or equivalent) will be carried out if appropriate.
  
We want to do all we can to create an environment and recruitment process where people feel safe and comfortable to talk about disability. For any reasonable adjustment requests as part of the recruitment and assessment process, please contact Roisin at ReasonableAdjustments@parkdean-resorts.com.

We are looking for three **Senior Software Developers (Management)** to be the **Technical Lead** of teams within our Defence and Transport Tribes to make a difference by supporting our customers around the world.

Join us to work with these exciting technologies and more, as we push the boundaries of weather and climate science for Transport and Defence Users.

To find out more about Technology at the Met Office, please take a look here.

As our Senior Developer - Management, the job may be suitable for hybrid working, which is where an employee works part of the week in the office and part of the week from home. This is a voluntary, non-contractual arrangement and the location advertised will be your contractual place of work.

Our opportunity is full time, 37 hours per week, based in Exeter. Our people are at the heart of what we do and we'll do our best to agree a working pattern that works for everyone.

**World changing work**

From science to technology, from meteorology to management, and from planning to communication, our expertise helps us stand out as the authority on weather accuracy and climate prediction. We help individuals, industries and government to make better decisions to stay safe and thrive. This is the Met Office. This is who we are.

* We’re a force for good - focusing on our environmental and social impact
* We’re experts by nature - always learning and developing to do things better
* We live and breathe it - putting our purpose at the heart of decision-making
* We’re better together - understanding partnerships and inclusivity make us greater
* We keep evolving - pushing boundaries to make tomorrow better for our customers

**Your world of expertise**

As a Senior Software Developer – Management, you will be responsible for a team of dedicated software engineers and testers who create and maintain systems which bridge the gap between our front-end products and back-end science, ensuring that we are able to make the very best use of our ever-evolving supercomputer capability.

In **Transport**, our focus is on developing and operating services for the global aviation community as part of our responsibility as a World Area Forecast Centre (one of only two in the world).

In **Defence**, we deliver mission-critical digital services, data products, and environmental intelligence that supports Defence operations worldwide. Our work enables informed decision-making, helping military personnel operate effectively in complex and challenging environments. We empower our people to lead through technical excellence, ownership, and a shared commitment to delivering real-world impact.

**You will lead and develop a high-performing team, providing clear direction, coaching and support to enhance capability, engagement and performance.**

**Your Key Duties**

* Provide technical and team leadership across the development lifecycle, guiding, mentoring, and inspiring engineers to deliver high-quality, resilient services.
* Plan and lead development on sets of related stories.
* Have an understanding of the whole system and take responsibility for teaching this to others.
* Work with other disciplines to understand what needs to be built and operate the production services you build.
* Coach and mentor more junior colleagues.
* Find ways to improve system robustness, resilience and stability.

**Why join us**

Our work is life-changing, often life-saving and always life-enhancing. The Met Office is Great Place to Work UK certified. We are also featured on their ‘Best Workplaces in Tech’ 2023, 2024 and 2025 lists, as well as their ’54 Best Workplaces for Women’ 2023 list.

As our Senior Software Developer – Management, your total reward package will be up to £65,568 annually, which includes:

* £43,081 base pay.
* An outstanding Civil Service pension, with an average employer contribution of 28.97%.
* Recruitment Retention Allowance (RRA) you will be paid £5,300 per annum as a market supplement to reflect the demand for your skills. Whilst in post, you will be paid this market driven allowance from April 2026 until March 2027 in your monthly pay.
* Annual Leave starting at 27.5 days (plus Bank Holidays) rising to 32.5 days (plus Bank Holidays) after 5 years and option to buy or sell up to 5 days per year of annual leave.

**Essential Criteria, skills and experience:**

* **Team Leadership:** Lead and support, including mentoring and coaching a geographically dispersed multi-disciplinary team. Represent your team and work with stakeholders to design and plan upcoming work and create an environment that empowers your team to deliver. Set and maintain team standards for engineering quality, security, and maintainability when solving complex problems. (**We’re better together**)
* **Programming and build (software engineering):** You can collaborate with others, when necessary, to review specifications. You can use the agreed specifications to design, code, test, and document programs or scripts of medium-to-high complexity, using modern standards and technologies including Java and Python. (**We’re expert by nature**)
* **Systems Design, Integration and Service Support:** You can design and review cost-efficient systems using design standards, methods, and tools, and ensure they are applied effectively. You can identify and articulate risks and their potential impacts. You can apply efficient use of resources and integration of multiple systems and technology. You can define the integration build and co-ordinate build activities across systems to undertake and support integration testing activities. You can identify, locate, and fix faults and design support processes for others to follow to keep services operational. (**We live and breathe it**)
* **User focus:** You can collaborate with user researchers and can represent users internally. You can explain the difference between user needs and the desires of the user. Champion user research to focus on all users. Prioritise and define approaches to understand the user story, guiding others in doing so. Offer recommendations on the best tools and methods to use.
* **Information Security:** You can understand information security and design solutions and services with security controls embedded, specifically engineered with mitigation of security threats as a core feature.

**How to apply**

If you share our values, we’d love to hear from you! Click apply to begin your application. Please complete your career history and provide evidence against each of the essential criteria in the supporting statement questionnaire. We recommend candidates use the CARL method (Context, Action, Result and Learning) for presenting evidence of experience and skills.

Closing date 08/10/2026 at 23:59 with first stage interviews commencing from 26/10/2026. You will hear from us once the closing date has passed.

**Using AI in your application**

We welcome applications that use AI tools for support in drafting or refining, as long as they accurately reflect your own skills and experience. All hiring decisions at the Met Office are made by people, not AI. For more details, visit our approach to recruitment.

**How we can help**

If you have any questions or would like to discuss this opportunity further, please contact us at careers@metoffice.gov.uk.

If you’re considering applying and need support to do so, please get in touch. You can request adjustments either within your application or by contacting us. Should you be offered an interview, please be aware there may be a selection exercise which could include a presentation, written test or a scenario-based activity. You can select in your application to be considered under the Disability Confident Scheme. To be invited to interview/assessment under this scheme, your application must meet the essential criteria for the role.

We understand that great minds don’t always think alike and as an equal opportunities employer we welcome applications from those with all protected characteristics. We recruit on merit, fairness, and open competition in line with the Civil Service Code.

We can only accept applications from those eligible to live and work in the UK - please refer to GOV.UK for information. We require Security Check clearance, for which you need to have resided in the UK for at least 3 of the last 5 years to be eligible, 2 of these years must be immediately preceding the point of your application.

If you feel that your application has not been treated in accordance with the Recruitment Principles, and wish to make a complaint, then in the first instance you should contact us at: **careers@metoffice.gov.uk** If you are not satisfied with the response that you receive, then you can contact the Civil Service Commission at: **info@csc.gov.uk**

title: Senior Software Engineer - .NET
description:
Role Overview

  

We are looking for an experienced Senior .NET Developer (C#) to join the Acquisitions & Originations engineering team within Experian's Credit & Verification Services business.

**The Domain**

The Acquisitions & Originations team develops and provides level 3 support for the Delphi Select and Evaluate platforms, which are used across the Acquisitions and Originations business. These are complex, configuration-driven, multi-client systems: each client (bank, lender or other financial institution) runs its own decisioning strategies, rules and data configurations on a shared codebase.

Clients depend on these systems to make real-time lending and origination decisions, so reliability, data integrity and controlled release processes are central to the role.

This is a hybrid, Nottingham based role (40% in the office) reporting to the Lead Developer.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own features end-to-end across the full software development lifecycle: requirements analysis, technical design, development, unit and integration testing, code review, deployment and post-release support.
* Design, develop and maintain scalable, maintainable C#/.NET services and components within a complex, multi-client system, ensuring changes are safe across all client configurations.
* Translate high-level and client-specific requirements into robust technical designs, in collaboration with the Technical Lead, Architects, Business Analysts and Product Owners.
* Maintain and improve automated test coverage (unit, integration and regression) to support safe, frequent releases into a live multi-client platform.
* Contribute to and help evolve CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins)
* Identify and help remediate technical debt, and contribute to ongoing modernisation of the platform, including its migration towards cloud-native (AWS) architecture.
* Mentor Intermediate and Junior developers, sharing technical knowledge and supporting their growth, including in the effective use of AI-assisted development tools.

  
  

Experience and Skills

  

**Required Skills / Knowledge**

* Strong expertise in .NET Core / .NET Framework and C#, including object-oriented design and common design patterns.
* Proven experience across the full software development lifecycle, ideally supporting a live, business-critical production system.
* Solid experience with SQL Server / T-SQL, including writing and optimising queries and stored procedures against production data.
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, and working with service-oriented or microservice architectures.
* Practical experience with unit and integration testing frameworks (e.g. xUnit, NUnit or MSTest).
* Experience with version control and CI/CD tooling (e.g. Git, Jenkins, or equivalent).
* Direct experience working in a Scrum or other Agile team, including sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives.
* Hands-on, everyday experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT) for tasks such as code generation, refactoring, test writing, debugging and documentation

**Useful Skills (beneficial, not mandatory)**

* Exposure to AWS services (e.g. DynamoDB, S3, EC2 ) or a strong interest in developing cloud skills as the platform migrates to AWS.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Knowledge of containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience in financial services, lending, credit decisioning or a similarly regulated domain.
* Exposure to front-end technologies such as React or modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience working with configuration-driven or rules-engine-based systems.

  
  

About Experian

  

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

**Internal Grade E/EB9**

Benefits include:-

* Great compensation package and discretionary bonus plan
* Core benefits include pension, bupa healthcare, sharesave scheme and more!
* 25 days annual leave with 8 bank holidays and 3 volunteering days. You can also purchase additional annual leave.

**Recruitment Fraud Awareness** - Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. title: ET 2027 | Graduate Scheme, Digital Forensics
description:
**Who We Are**

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

**About The Role**

The Digital Forensics & Investigations team is part of our Technology practice that brings together over 500 professionals around the world in a broad range of disciplines from forensic investigations to cloud technology, blockchain, data privacy, software development, AI and more.

**What You’ll Do**

This Consultant position in the Digital Forensics & Investigations team based in London is an opportunity to start your career as a professional in a team of specialists, dedicated to solving the challenges of our broad client base.

You will be part of a growing team of digital forensics professionals responsible for advising and delivering services to our clients, including:

* Identify and acquire digital evidence to forensic standards, on-site at client premises around the UK and abroad
* Utilise industry standard and bespoke software to access, extract and handle data from mobile devices, computers, servers and cloud data sources
* Perform forensic analysis and reporting for a wide range of data sources under supervision of senior staff
* Liaise with clients and senior staff to manage work
* Research and develop custom solutions and apply to client needs
* Be service-oriented to meet client deadlines, including working out of business hours when necessary
* Travel as required, which may be at short notice.

**How You’ll Grow**

Consultants experience a broad range of clients, technologies, business challenges, bespoke solutions and working environments. Throughout the role, you will have opportunities to manage sections of projects, develop custom solutions and build internal and external relationships.

You will work with your Performance Coach on a development and training plan to ensure experience across the digital forensic lifecycle to support your professional development.

You may also have the opportunity to travel as part of projects or secondments, most commonly to our clients’ offices in Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

We expect successful candidates to demonstrate a willingness and capacity to develop skills that are transferable across disciplines in the Technology practice, and support this through a mixture of internal and external training courses and on-the-job exposure to new areas.

**What You Will Need to Succeed**

Basic Qualifications

* University graduate/final year student who can work full-time from **6th September 2027**
* Achieved/predicted a minimum 2:1 degree (or equivalent) in forensic computing or a technology, criminal or legal-focused subject, or equivalent experience.
* Familiarity with forensic principles and technologies
* A keen interest in forensic practices and protocols
* Familiarity with mobile device, cloud and personal computer systems

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working in a digital forensics or related role or university project
* Knowledge of forensic imaging and analysis tools such as Encase, Cellebrite or X-Ways
* Ability to handle data using tools such as Excel, MS Access, SQL and other tools
* Knowledge of programming or scripting (Python, Java, C#, Visual Basic, PowerShell)
* Enthusiasm for technology and an interest in technical developments
* Self-developer that demonstrates an ability to solve complex problems with well thought out solutions
* Ability to manage time and prioritise tasks effectively
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team and support the team’s goals
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while handling multiple tasks through to completion
* Ability to communicate effectively in a client facing role
* Flexible working hours and ability to work in a cross-functional team

**How to apply**

The deadline for applications is: **29th October 2026**

**STEP 1** : Complete our online application form and submit your CV (no cover letter required).

**STEP 2** : Complete our Pre-recorded Video application questions.

**STEP 3** : Attend a competency-based virtual interview to explore your skills and motivations between **23rd - 27th of November 2026** .

**STEP 3** : Attend a 2nd virtual interview with our senior managers between **1st – 11th December 2026** .

**STEP 4** : Job offers are made to successful candidates before **25 December 2026** .

title: IT Developer Graduate Programme
description:
* **Location(s):**
* Swindon, Wiltshire, GB, SN5 6PB

**RWE Supply & Trading GmbH**

**Start date:** September 2027  
**Salary:** starting at £41,000 p.a

Are you looking to kickstart your career at a company where you can truly make an impact? Whether we’re delivering power to millions, trading in new markets around the globe, or driving the rapid growth of renewable energy, RWE is at the forefront of the industry. But we wouldn’t be there without world-class IT.

  

**About the role**

The IT Developer Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who want to build a career in software engineering and application development, placing you at the heart of our commercial business.

Through a series of hands-on technical rotations, you’ll work closely with analysts and business support teams to deliver solutions for our energy trading and commercial operations teams, while developing expertise in programming, cloud-native technologies and DevOps practices.

Along the way, you’ll broaden your technical stack and business knowledge, gain experience across a range of programming languages and working environments, and build an understanding of different teams and cultures, providing a strong foundation for your permanent role and long-term career development.

You’ll learn about our global business from the inside – working on meaningful projects in areas including:

* Application development.
* Embedded IT for our commercial business such as trading of energy commodities, freight and logistics, commercial asset optimisation or sales and origination.
* Enterprise Integration focus on the transport layer within RWEST’s application landscape and works closely together with other IT and business teams to optimise the systems.
* Market Data Solutions are the fuel for decision-making, automated trading, and fundamental analysis within the Energy Trading industry.
* Central Services are positioned in middle layer (Integration) applications connecting to various other departments like BackOffice, Risk and Front Office etc. involving incident management, automated standard service requests, working with concepts of DevOps and Squad model and migration of application to cloud based infrastructure.
* IT projects with business attention such as “Lead in Data” or “Lead in Cloud”.

Digital technologies, including AI-enabled tools, are becoming an integral part of how we work at RWE. Throughout the programme, you will have opportunities to use these tools responsibly to enhance productivity, support decision-making, foster innovation and improve ways of working, always in line with RWE policies and responsible use principles.

Whichever team you join, you’ll be welcomed as an equal. Your perspective will be valued. You’ll be trusted to deliver the work you’re given. And with each new rotation, you’ll develop the skills and knowledge you need to become an industry expert.

  

**Job requirements and experiences**

Are you passionate about IT, digital technologies, and innovative solutions? Committed to building a career in the energy industry? Keen to learn, grow and take ownership and accountability? Then you could be just the kind of exceptional person we’re looking for. Some relevant work experience would be an advantage but is not essential.

  

As well as a keen interest in the energy industry and the readiness to explore our markets and our business, you’ll need:

* A degree (BSc, MSc or PhD) in IT or a similar statistical or numerate subject such as Mathematics, Engineering or Economics.
* Knowledge of at least one of the following programming languages - C#, Java or Python.
* Passion for IT development and working in a DevOps environment.
* Interest in AI, Automation, and other emerging technologies.
* A positive, team-oriented approach to work.
* Motivation to take on new challenges.
* A commercial and analytical mindset.
* Adaptability and the ability to learn quickly.
* Enthusiasm for developing your skills and exploring new opportunities.

title: Junior ServiceNow Consultant
description:
**Company Description**

For over 30 years, **Version 1** has been a leading Oracle partner specialising in Enterprise Applications, delivering ERP, HCM and EPM solutions that enable organisations to transform and modernise their core systems.

Combining deep domain expertise with end-to-end delivery and managed services, we support some of the UK and Ireland’s largest organisations in driving business value through Oracle technology.

* Top-tier Oracle partner across Database, Platform, ERP, and Managed Services
* **37 UKOUG awards** over the last 3 years
* **13 awards** - UK Oracle User Group (UKOUG) Community Awards 2026 (4 Gold, 5 Silver, 4 Bronze)
* Certified Great Place to Work
* Recognised as a **leader in AI & digital transformation consulting** with global delivery footprint

With **3,800+ people** and revenues exceeding **€347m/£302m**, Version 1 is a market leader in Oracle, Microsoft, and AWS consulting services – and one of the fastest-growing digital consultancies in Europe.

 **Job Description**

**Junior ServiceNow Consultant**

**YOU MUST BE ELIGIBLE FOR CTC CLEARANCE. TO BE ELIGIBLE YOU MUST HAVE LIVED IN THE UK FOR THE LAST 3 YEARS.**

**3 DAYS PER WEEK ONSITE IN OUR BELFAST OFFICE.**

**Start Your Career in ServiceNow Consulting**

Are you passionate about technology and looking for an opportunity to build a rewarding career in one of the world's leading enterprise platforms?

At Version 1, we're looking for ambitious and motivated early-career technologists to join our Enterprise Applications Service Management team as Junior ServiceNow Developers.

You don't need previous ServiceNow experience.

What matters is your enthusiasm for technology, willingness to learn, and desire to build a long-term consulting career.

From day one, you'll receive structured training, mentoring from experienced consultants, and hands-on experience working on real client projects.

We'll support you through professional certifications and give you the tools, knowledge, and experience needed to develop into a successful ServiceNow Consultant.

Whether you're a recent graduate, career changer, or aspiring developer with a passion for technology, this programme is designed to help you succeed.

**What You'll Learn**

**As part of your development journey, you'll gain experience across:**

* ServiceNow platform administration and configuration
* IT Service Management (ITSM) processes and best practices
* Workflow automation and business process improvement
* ServiceNow application support and maintenance
* REST APIs and platform integrations
* Oracle Fusion Cloud fundamentals across ERP and HCM
* Software development and scripting concepts
* Agile delivery methodologies
* Platform security, governance, and quality assurance
* Version control using Git
* Technical documentation and solution design

**What You'll Do**

**Working alongside experienced consultants and technical specialists, you will:**

* Support the configuration and enhancement of the ServiceNow platform
* Assist in maintaining platform stability, performance, and usability
* Help investigate and resolve incidents and service requests
* Contribute to software releases, platform improvements, and new functionality
* Participate in client workshops and requirements gathering activities
* Support the creation of technical documentation and user stories
* Learn best practices in platform administration, development, and governance
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary delivery teams on enterprise-scale programmes
* Continuously expand your technical knowledge through training and certifications

As your skills grow, you'll take on increasing responsibility and progress towards independently delivering solutions for our clients.

 **Qualifications**

**What We're Looking For**

**We're more interested in your potential than your experience.**

**Essential**

**You will have:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, OR demonstrable technical aptitude gained through projects, apprenticeships, bootcamps, or self-directed learning
* Basic knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language such as JavaScript, Python, Java, SQL, or similar
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent attention to detail
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Genuine enthusiasm for technology and continuous learning
* Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
* Right to work in the UK

**Desirable**

**You will have:**

* Exposure to Service Desk or ITSM platforms
* Knowledge of APIs, cloud technologies, or reporting tools
* Previous internship, placement year, apprenticeship, or technical project experience
* Awareness of Agile delivery practices

  
**Additional Information**

**What's In It For You?**

* Structured training pathway into ServiceNow consulting and delivery
* Fully sponsored ServiceNow certifications
* Dedicated mentoring from experienced consultants and architects
* Hands-on experience working on live client projects
* Clear and transparent career progression framework
* Ongoing investment in technical and professional development
* Exposure to enterprise technologies and transformation programmes
* Hybrid working model with flexibility built around team and client needs
* Supportive, collaborative, and inclusive culture

**Build Your Future with Version 1**

This is more than a trainee role. It's an opportunity to begin a long-term career with one of the UK's leading digital transformation and technology consulting organisations.

If you're curious, ambitious, and excited by the opportunity to learn, grow, and work with cutting-edge technologies, we'd love to hear from you.

**Why Join Version 1's Oracle Practice?**

* Join a global Oracle practice of **700+ specialists**, supported by **500+ certified professionals** across the Oracle ecosystem.
* Work on **large-scale, multi-pillar Oracle Cloud transformation programmes** for some of the UK's most recognised organisations.
* Collaborate with a **high-performing, market-leading Oracle team** renowned for delivering complex enterprise transformation projects.
* Be part of an organisation that provides **end-to-end Oracle services**, including consulting and advisory, implementation, integration, cloud infrastructure, and managed services.
* Leverage our deep **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)** expertise to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing cloud solutions for enterprise clients.
* Accelerate your career through our **Strength in Balance** and leadership development programmes, supported by quarterly **Pathways** career reviews.
* Benefit from a substantial **training and certification budget**, helping you stay at the forefront of Oracle technologies and industry best practices.

title: Software Engineers
description:
**Details**
-----------

### **Reference number**

481865

### **Salary**

£42,630

Made up of a base salary of £35,134, a concessionary payment of £2,758, and a skills payment of up to £4,738 from day one, reflecting the skills and experience you demonstrate during the selection process. Plus, a £2,000 recruitment bonus.

GBP

### **Job grade**

Executive Officer

### **Contract type**

Permanent

### **Type of role**

Information Technology

### **Working pattern**

Full-time, Part-time, Compressed hours

### **Number of jobs available**

1

**Contents**
------------

* Location
* About the job
* Benefits
* Things you need to know
* Apply and further information

**Location**
------------

Manchester

**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**

As a Software Engineer, youll work as part of an Agile team to solve complex technical challenges using a variety of software engineering methods, languages and frameworks, including JavaScript, Java, Node.js, Python, Rust and Go.

### **Job description**

From day one, youll contribute to meaningful projects while continuing to develop and broaden your technical skills. Youll work across a variety of environments, including on-premises and cloud-based solutions, collaborating with other engineers to deliver innovative and scalable systems.

Youll have the opportunity to contribute to large-scale projects, share knowledge with the wider engineering community and learn from experienced colleagues. We encourage engineers to take ownership of their work and provide the support and autonomy needed to develop their expertise.

If youre successful in securing a Software Engineer role, please note that occasional travel to another GCHQ site may be required. Where overnight stays are necessary, GCHQ will fully cover travel and accommodation expenses.

Beyond delivering impactful work, youll be part of a culture that values collaboration, learning and development, where everyone is encouraged to contribute and reach their potential.

### **Person specification**

Youll be able to demonstrate solid programming fundamentals and proficiency in at least one modern language or framework, such as Go, Java, JavaScript, Node js, Python or Rust.

To join us, youll need a higher education background in a STEM subject (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics), gained through a degree, apprenticeship, or equivalent qualification. Applications from candidates in the final year of their studies are welcome.

Practical experience in software engineering is also required and may have been gained through software development projects, employment, internships, industrial placements or summer placements.

Naturally curious and analytical, youll enjoy solving problems and take a logical, persistent approach to technical challenges. Youll be keen to explore new ideas and broaden your knowledge.

You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, sharing information in a way that supports collaboration and effective delivery. You work well with others, value different perspectives, and contribute positively within a team environment.

Experience with generative AI would be advantageous, including AI-assisted development tools, agentic patterns, or applications that use large language models. An understanding of how to use these technologies responsibly, securely and effectively would also be beneficial. Most importantly, curiosity and a willingness to develop your knowledge as these technologies evolve will help you succeed in the role.

A passion for technology and the ability to thrive in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing and continuous learning are valued will help you succeed in the role.

**Benefits**
------------

**Rewards and benefits**

Youll receive a base salary of £35,134, a concessionary payment of £2,758, and a skills payment of up to £4,738, assessed at interview and awarded from day one, giving a starting salary of £42,631. Plus, a £2,000 recruitment bonus.

* 25 days annual leave, automatically rising to 30 days after five years' service, plus 10.5 days of public and privilege holidays

* opportunities to be recognised through our employee performance scheme

* interest-free season ticket loan

* an excellent pension scheme

* a cycle to work scheme

* on-site facilities such as a subsidised gym, restaurant and on-site coffee bars (available at some locations)

* paid parental and adoption leave.

**Training and development**

We invest heavily in professional development and provide a range of learning opportunities to help you build your skills and progress your career.

Youll have a minimum of 30% of your working time dedicated to development activities, with access to training through courses, conferences, technical communities, self-directed study and project-based learning.

We actively support professional and academic development, including industry-recognised certifications, post graduate study and professional registration. Funding is available for relevant qualifications and certifications, such as Scrum Master, CISSP and AWS Certified Developer.

Youll have opportunities to develop expertise across a range of software engineering disciplines, including front-end development, site reliability engineering, data engineering, solutions architecture, machine learning operations (MLOps), user experience (UX), Agile delivery and cloud engineering.

Youll also benefit from mentoring, coaching and collaboration with experienced engineers, helping you broaden your technical knowledge and develop your career within our engineering community.

**Things you need to know**
---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

### **Selection process details**

**What to expect**

Our recruitment process is fair, transparent, and based on merit. Here is a brief overview of each stage, in order:

* An initial online application form including pre-screening questions to ensure you meet our eligibility criteria.

* Online Situational Judgement Test (SJT) in which you rate the appropriateness of responses to a series of short scenarios.

* In-person assessment centre

Please note, you must successfully pass each stage of the process to progress to the next. Your application may take around 6 to 9 months to process, including vetting, so we advise that you continue in any current employment until you have received your final job offer.

**Equal opportunities**

At GCHQ, diversity and inclusion are critical to our mission. To protect the UK, we need a truly diverse workforce that reflects the society we serve. This includes diversity in every sense of the word: those with different backgrounds, ages, ethnicities, gender identities, sexual orientations, ways of thinking and those with disabilities or neurodivergent conditions. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from everyone, including those from groups that are under-represented in our workforce, such as women, people from ethnic minority backgrounds, people with disabilities, and those from low socio-economic backgrounds.

Find out more about our culture, working environment and diversity on our website.

**Were Disability Confident**

GCHQ is proud to have achieved Leader status within the Department for Work and Pensions Disability Confident scheme. This is aimed at encouraging employers to think differently about disability and take action to improve how they recruit, retain, and develop disabled people.

As a Disability Confident Leader, we aim to ensure that a fair and proportionate number of disabled applicants who best meet the essential minimum criteria for this position will be offered an interview, where practical. This is known as an Offer of an interview.

* Youll be required to reach the minimum pass park for the online Situational Judgement Test (SJT), which assesses criteria important for all roles in our organisation.

* A STEM background in Higher Education that could include a degree, apprenticeship or equivalent qualification. Well consider candidates who have completed or are in their final year.

* Practical software engineering experience this could be gained through practical software projects, relevant employment, internships, industrial placements, or summer placements

* Ability to demonstrate knowledge of at least one modern language/framework, such as Go, Java, JavaScript, NodeJS, Python, or Rust.

Note: The above criteria will be assessed during the application sift.

**Before you apply**

To work at GCHQ, you need to be a British citizen or hold dual British nationality. Read about our eligibility criteria.

This role requires the highest level of security clearance, known as Developed Vetting (DV). Its something everyone in the UK Intelligence Community undertakes. Find out more about the vetting process.

Please note we have a strict drugs policy. Once you start your application, you must not take any recreational drugs, and youll need to declare your previous drug usage at the relevant stage.

Before you apply, we advise you to consider setting up a separate email address for your contact with us, to ensure your personal and application correspondence remain separate. Try to avoid having identifying information in your email address, such as your first name, surname or date of birth. This is good practice and will help you manage your application with us more securely.

The role is based in Manchester, so youll need to live within a commutable distance. Please consider any financial implications and practicalities before submitting an application, as we do not offer relocation costs.

We offer reasonable reimbursement of travel costs for candidates attending in‑person appointments during the recruitment and vetting process. Full details will be provided with your interview or assessment invitation.

Reimbursement is discretionary and will only be made in line with the Candidate Expenses Policy, as amended from time to time. Candidates must book their own travel, using the most economical option and provide original hard copy receipts for reimbursement.

Please note you should only launch your application from within the UK. If you are based overseas, you should wait until you visit the UK to launch an application. Applying from outside the UK will impact our ability to progress your application. You should not discuss your application with anyone other than your partner or a close family member.

**Right to withdraw statement:**

Please be aware that we reserve the right to close applications once a certain number have been received. To avoid missing out, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. If you have a disability (as defined under the Equality Act 2010) and need additional time to complete your application, please submit your initial application and then contact us using the email address provided as soon as possible, please use the subject line Reasonable Adjustments Extension and briefly outline the support you require.

Please note, it is this organisations policy not to provide feedback at any stage of the recruitment process. This may be contrary to the message below.

  
  
  
Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview or assessment.

### **Security**

Successful candidates must meet the security requirements before they can be appointed. The level of security needed is developed vetting .
  
  
See our vetting charter .

People working with government assets must complete baseline personnel security standard (opens in new window) checks.

### **Nationality requirements**

Open to UK nationals only.

### **Working for the Civil Service**

Please note this Post is NOT regulated by the Civil Service Commission.

The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria.

### **Diversity and Inclusion**

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy .

* Ensuring high performance and responsiveness across different devices
* Integrating mobile applications with RESTful APIs and backend services
* Optimising applications for performance, usability, and accessibility
* Ensuring app security and compliance with best practices
* Collaborating with front-end and backend developers to ensure seamless mobile and web integration

* Proven, demonstrable experience in native Android development using Kotlin, including modern language features (e.g. coroutines, Flow) — this is not an entry-level or graduate role
* Jetpack Compose and XML layouts
* MVVM and Clean Architecture
* Room, Dependency Injection (Hilt), Retrofit/OkHttp
* REST APIs and GraphQL

* Confident working with GitHub for version control and collaborative development

* The Android build system (build variants/flavours, signing configs)
* Android Device Policy manager (device admin/managed devices)
* Building custom Android SDKs
* NFC
* Firebase
* Multi display/secondary display support
* Node.js and/or React
* AWS including Lambda and API Gateway: IoT/MQTT 5
* SQL/MySQL
* Infrastructure as Code (SAM, CloudFormation, Terraform or CDK)
* Payments/fintech domain exposure
* Git/GitHub workflow and CI/CD
* Experience using AI tools in development
* Javascript
* Typescript
* Python
* Java

**Security**

Given the nature of our business, experience of security in development and systems would be highly beneficial. This includes:

* Writing secure code and following secure coding practices
* Identifying and mitigating common application vulnerabilities
* Experience with secure API design and authentication/authorisation
* Awareness of data protection and compliance requirements relevant to payments
* Contributing to a security-conscious culture across the development team

**What We Offer**

* The chance to shape a fast-growing payments business with genuine ambition
* A collaborative, in-house development environment
* A monthly wellbeing budget of £30
* Quarterly paid social events
* Workplace pension with NEST
* Hybrid working from a Portsmouth-based office

At American Express, we empower technologists to learn, innovate, and make an impact from day one. As an AI Engineer I in Enterprise Technology Services, you’ll join a full-time graduate program and contribute to technology work that helps teams explore, build, test, and responsibly scale AI-enabled solutions.

In this role, you may support work across machine learning, generative AI, intelligent automation, data pipelines, retrieval patterns, model evaluation, LLM integrations, AI agents, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software features. You’ll collaborate with engineering, product, data, security, risk, and business partners to help deliver enterprise AI solutions responsibly, reliably, and securely.

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Must have earned a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or another technical field before the full-time start date.
* Students must have a graduation date between December 2026 and June 2027
* Knowledge of Python and foundational data processing technologies.
* Foundational understanding of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, debugging, testing, and problem solving.
* Foundational understanding of machine learning concepts such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, model training, evaluation, feature engineering, and experimentation.
* Introductory understanding of modern AI systems, including LLM APIs, prompt-based interactions, retrieval patterns, AI powered tools, or generative AI applications.
* Ability to support AI/ML development, testing, documentation, integration, or data pipeline activities under guidance.
* Awareness of responsible AI expectations, including reliability, safety, governance, security, privacy, compliance, and appropriate escalation when work is unclear or outside standard guidance.
* Strong communication, collaboration, documentation, and learning agility with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience through academic coursework, research, projects, open-source contributions, internships, hackathons, or extracurricular activities using Python, R, Java, JavaScript, or similar technologies.
* Interest in machine learning, generative AI, natural language processing, intelligent automation, data engineering, agentic AI, or AI-enabled software development.
* Familiarity with NLP techniques and model concepts such as fuzzy matching, embeddings, BERT, transformers, LLMs, or other modern language models.
* Exposure to LLM APIs or similar AI models, including prompt engineering, prompt evaluation, tools, function calling, retrieval patterns, or agent workflow concepts.
* Experience or coursework involving machine learning algorithms and applying them to practical or real-world problems.
* Familiarity with APIs, data pipelines, ETL processes, cloud environments, containerized development, model deployment patterns, or monitoring.
* Awareness of CI/CD, version control, testing, code reviews, Agile development, and collaborative software engineering workflows.
* Exposure to version control systems such as Git and collaborative software development workflows.
Curiosity for AI powered developer tools, responsible AI practices, governance, security, model documentation, and enterprise-scale delivery.  

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United Kingdom is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

  

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

* Competitive base salaries
* Flexible work arrangements and schedules with hybrid and virtual options with Amex Flex
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counselling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: 2027 Technology Developer Summer Internship Programme Knutsford
description:
Date live: 09/09/2026

Business Area: See job description

Area of Expertise: Early Careers

Contract: Intern

Reference Code: JR-0000129381

  

**Explore the world of Barclays as a Summer Intern**

  
  

Spend 10 weeks diving into real projects, gaining hands-on experience, and shaping your future. You’ll receive full support, take on meaningful responsibilities, and build lasting connections—all while discovering what makes our culture unique.

  
  

If you're in your penultimate year and ready to grow, learn, and make an impact, this is your opportunity to belong and thrive.

**Our Expert Programme**

  
  

You'll join our expert programme, a 1 year targeted, fast-track programme designed to give you depth and breadth of experience. Participating in job-based bespoke training from the start enabling you to go fully-equipped into your role as you develop specialist technical expertise.

**Why the Technology Developer programme?**

  
  

As a Developer, you’ll help design, build, test and maintain systems used across Barclays. This is more than writing code; you’ll play a role in solving complex problems for clients and customers. You may work with technologies including Java, C++, C#, Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, containers, DevOps, cloud, machine learning, scripting and real-time systems.

  
  

To be considered for this opportunity, you must be in your penultimate year of university. You must be graduating in 2028.

  
  

You’ll also bring a genuine interest in technology, strong problem-solving skills and the drive to deliver innovative solutions.

  
  

The location for this role is indicated in the job title, and you will be based at that location. If you are successful in receiving a return offer to our graduate programme, your location will be the same as it was during your internship.

  
  

Barclays will accept applications from candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the UK and will provide a skilled worker visa for successful applicants if they meet the Home Office’s eligibility criteria for a skilled worker visa.

  

Successful applicants who are not eligible to receive a skilled worker visa, and who we are therefore unable to secure a skilled worker visa for, will be required to have their own legal right to work in the UK on a full-time basis from June 2027 to August 2027.

**Working In Knutsford**

  
  

Set in 64 acres of gardens and centred around the historic Radbroke Hall, our Knutsford campus blends heritage with innovation. We’re redeveloping the site into a world-class, sustainable workspace that fosters collaboration and wellbeing.

  
  

Colleagues enjoy a vibrant community with clubs and activities ranging from yoga and running to beekeeping and boardgames. With free shuttle buses from nearby transport hubs and onsite parking, getting here is easy too.

  
  

It is the policy of Barclays to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.

  
  

The closing date for applications is 31 October 2026. Please note that this vacancy may close ahead of the advertised date due to application volumes, and we therefore recommend submitting your application as early as possible.

**Purpose of the role**

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participation in code reviews, and promotion of a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
